notes.title: THIS WEEK ON KAIROS
notes.content:
[p]Hey Vault Hunters! Welcome to “This Week on Kairos” - a weekly post where we share everything happening across the world of [i]Borderlands 4[/i], from developer updates to community highlights and beyond.[/p][p]Every Friday, we’ll be here with the latest news, fan creations, dev spotlights, helpful resources, and anything else we think you’ll want to see. Whether you're looking to catch up, dive deeper, or just see what your fellow players are up to, this is the place.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/03fac58a5b167c6b4b9e2acddebab532de13f6c6.png"][/img][/p][h3]Our Latest Update:[/h3][p]We’ve rolled out several updates since launch, with more coming soon. Here’s what you may have missed:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1285190/view/534362428708749730"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]A guide on how to submit a ticket can be found here: [/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/1285190/discussions/2/673972930559959886/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/1285190/discussions/2/673972930559959886/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]When you submit a ticket, please remember to attach your DxDiag or MSinfo file. If you need assistance with doing that, here’s a walkthrough:[/p][p][url="https://support.borderlands.com/hc/en-us/articles/44564441894291-PC-How-do-I-attach-a-DxDiag-and-MSinfo-file"]https://support.borderlands.com/hc/en-us/articles/44564441894291-PC-How-do-I-attach-a-DxDiag-and-MSinfo-file[/url][/p][p][/p][p][i](Note: This section is going to be structured the same each week, so although it looks the same, rest assured it’s being updated weekly!)[/i][/p][p]
[/p][h3]See a new Vault Hunter this weekend![/h3][p]We’ll be at the Tokyo Game Show this weekend! Get ready for your introduction to the first of two new Vault Hunters coming to [i]Borderlands 4[/i] as part of the paid Story Pack* DLCs. We'll be showing off this new playable character during the Gearbox panel at Tokyo Game Show 2025 this Saturday, September 27, starting at 7:30 PM PT / 9:30 PM CT / 10:30 PM ET![/p][p][/p][p]You can watch the Gearbox panel at the times listed above over on the Tokyo Game Show[url="https://www.twitch.tv/tokyogameshow6"] [u]Twitch[/u][/url] or[url="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UClFyIegrk4g6CFqGYCwTViA"] [u]YouTube[/u][/url] channels. We can't wait for you to meet this new Vault Hunter![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/cb30a613f6b478418a4f460f9d1814bd70245459.png"][/img][/p][h3]Rafa Community Challenge: YOLT[/h3][p]Hope you don’t have any plans this weekend, because a new Community Challenge has commenced! [/p][p][/p][p][b]COMMUNITY CHALLENGE: YOLT[/b][/p][p][b]From September 26-28, collectively get 20,000,000 Second Winds as Rafa this weekend to earn:[/b][/p][list][*][p]"Savings Savior" Vault Hunter skin usable by[url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/rafa/"] [u]Rafa[/u][/url][/p][/*][/list][p]To get a Second Wind, you need to kill an enemy while you're in the Fight For Your Life downed state, which will instantly spring you back into the action![/p][p]For all the information on this challenge, check out the Steam announcement: [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1285190/view/534362428708749894"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3]Steam Community Screenshots[/h3][p]As you take screenshots and drop them in Steam, we’ll round up a few of our favorites for your viewing pleasure. Enjoy the beauty of chaos - er, I mean, Kairos![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3572290103"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3574146279"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3573629190"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3572517835"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/3eb983867a8afaee766c69b0e8e47126b05a0d15.png"][/img][/p][h3]Behind the Team: Brandon Schulz, [i]Borderlands 4[/i] NPC Designer[/h3][p]Every week, we’re spotlighting one of the minds behind the mayhem. You’ll get to learn about folks from both Gearbox and 2K, and how each person who touches the game both influences and is influenced by [i]Borderlands 4[/i]. This week, we're talking with [b]Brandon Schulz[/b], Gearbox’s NPC Designer[b]:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]How do you approach creating characters that feel alive in such a wild, over-the-top universe?[/b][/p][p][b]Brandon[/b]: So much of what makes the [i]Borderlands[/i] universe so wild and over-the-top are[i] [/i]the characters themselves. In that way, our Narrative team makes my job easy when it comes to making those characters feel alive in gameplay—we simply take their wackiest, most unique characteristics and translate them into player-facing NPC mechanics. For example, Amara is known as the world-famous "Tiger of Partali," a ruthless (but also flashy) fighter who is often characterized by her ability to conjure six individual Siren arms: as such, when designing her NPC combat abilities for [i]BL4[/i], we made sure to emphasize that ruthless-but-flashy fighting style not only by referencing what players already know and love about [i]playing her[/i] in [i]BL3[/i], but also by taking inspiration from fighting games that personify hand-to-hand combat so well.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s the balance between narrative goals and gameplay needs when designing characters?[/b][/p][p][b]Brandon[/b]: Generally speaking, we find that balance by starting with two constraints: 1) What is [i]needed[/i] from a gameplay standpoint, and 2) What [i]makes sense[/i] given the narrative background for that NPC.[/p][p]With that, we essentially create a Venn Diagram with those constraints on either end, and start brainstorming ideas that hopefully land in the middle where there is an overlap. Sometimes the lines need to be fudged a bit on one side or the other—it can be a bit of a push and pull process—but ultimately in the end we’ll always go with whatever sounds/feels the most fun. From there, it’s all about playtesting, iterating, and responding to feedback until the NPC feels both mechanically satisfying and narratively authentic.[/p][p]
[/p][h3]Community Creative Corner[/h3][p]Our community members aren’t just gamers—many of you are also artists. Whether it’s cosplay, digital art, or some yet-to-be-invented medium, we’re your biggest fans. Check out this week’s hand-picked fan creations:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/ca225490765bdb89559319e12a2a9ab65fda8197.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i][u][url="https://www.tumblr.com/rottenzone"]- rottenzone[/url][/u][/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/1d919cff9a1d38ff3991c62cc77cf509a3ad787f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/67cd722d5a400eba9831541121e6add02e0e1fbb.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i][u][url="https://www.tumblr.com/krotiation"]- krotiation[/url][/u][/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/563a8929d3af73a06910468d8a521d583b66e2a2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i][u][url="https://www.tumblr.com/flippythedog200"]- flippythedog200[/url][/u][/i][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/1ac8af64c921b9f8d4366cd8d0041e552a892963.png"][/img][/p][p]That’s it for this week—with more updates, more chaos, and maybe a few surprises coming next Friday. Until then: keep your ECHOnet tuned and your loot luck high.[/p][p]Happy Hunting,
[b]The Borderlands Team[/b][/p][p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/cab2860dd2091c9cc501e726e1b96f9a4579849a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1285190/Borderlands_4/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Rafa Community Challenge: YOLT
notes.content:
[p]Every Vault Hunter in [i]Borderlands 4[/i] is a full-on badass, but you've probably picked your favorite by now. We want to see everyone excited to rep their go-to Vault Hunter, or expand their horizons and try rolling a new character class—so we're kicking off a series of Community Challenges that'll unlock a new cosmetic for each Vault Hunter![/p][p][/p][p]Just like with the [url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/news/break-free-pack/"][u]Break Free Pack[/u][/url], we'll be monitoring stats behind the scenes to track how much mayhem [i]Borderlands 4[/i] players are collectively causing. If the Community Challenge conditions are met by the end date, we'll share out a SHiFT code for the reward that'll be redeemable by all. We're kicking things off with a Community Challenge featuring [url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/rafa/"][u]Rafa the Exo-Soldier[/u][/url]:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/c7535539d9a5352eb2878a19666f05ccb2b4c9f1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]COMMUNITY CHALLENGE: YOLT[/b][/p][p][b]From September 26-28, collectively get 20,000,000 Second Winds as Rafa this weekend to earn:[/b][/p][list][*][p]"Savings Savior" Vault Hunter skin usable by [url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/rafa/"][u]Rafa[/u][/url]*[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]To get a Second Wind, you need to kill an enemy while you're in the Fight For Your Life downed state, which will instantly spring you back into the action! If you hadn't already guessed from the name, this Community Challenge is themed around Rafa's Character Short "YOLT" where he gets more than enough kills to get back up off the ground:[/p][p]
[/p][previewyoutube="REP1cuGbP-8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]And don't worry, we're not excluding the other Vault Hunters—we're prepping Community Challenges with a Vault Hunter Skin reward for [url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/vex/"][u]Vex[/u][/url], [url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/amon/"][u]Amon[/u][/url], and [url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/harlowe/"][u]Harlowe[/u][/url] in the coming weeks. [/p][p][/p][p]While you're wreaking havoc as Rafa this weekend, make sure you don't miss the new Vault Hunter reveal at the [i]Borderlands 4 [/i]panel happening at Tokyo Game Show 2025; [url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/news/tokyo-game-show-vault-hunter-reveal/"][u]full details here[/u][/url]![/p][p][/p][p]Whether you choose to blast enemies with Rafa's Peacebreaker Cannons and APOPHIS Lance or slice them up with his twin Arc-Knives, get out there and show us how easily you bounce back from the brink of defeat![/p][p][/p][p]*[i]Requires a copy of Borderlands 4, SHiFT Account, and Internet connection. Must redeem by December 31, 2030. One redemption per SHiFT Account. Terms apply[/i]. [/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1285190/Borderlands_4/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Borderlands 4 update delivers Vault Hunter and weapon buffs, but more is coming
notes.content:
A new Borderlands 4 update today delivers some welcome buffs across Gearbox's latest looter shooter. Sixteen years since it began (oh no, I'm old), the latest incarnation of the fabled Vault-hunting adventure is back, and it's one of the best co-op games of the year. But PC performance problems continue to cause concerns for many, and the developer is working on buffing out some of its rough edges. Alongside this, these Borderlands 4 patch notes roll out a range of character and weapon buffs, bug fixes, and even some menu improvements.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Borderlands 4's latest update aims to deliver more performance fixes, ends up causing more stuttering for some
notes.content:
Another day, another Borderlands 4 update aiming to smooth out more of the performance problems which have plagued the looter shooter since launch, especially on PC. Unfortuntely, this latest patch looks to have led to an uptick in stuttering for some players, with Gearbox recommending some shader messing around as a potential fix.

In fairness to the studio, you can't say they haven't been working hard to get Borderlands 4 running a bit more smoothly since problems in that department became apparent, with this being the third post-launch patch targeting performance in the past couple of weeks. One of them was confusingly noteless, but hey.

Read more

notes.title: Borderlands 4 Update Notes - September 25, 2025
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/4cde8b69bdc6318907408d352b5a018c00079fe3.png"][/img][/p][p]This update brings new Weekly Activities, stability and performance improvements, adjustments to some rewards/progression, and further refinements across UI, audio, visuals, and gear. Please restart your game to ensure that the update goes through and to prevent connection errors in matchmaking.[/p][p][/p][p]If you're encountering any issues, please [url="https://support.borderlands.com/hc/en-us/requests/new?ticket_form_id=32130122043795"][u]contact 2K Support[/u][/url] for direct assistance. You can also read the [url="https://support.borderlands.com/hc/en-us/articles/44493923901971-Borderlands-4-PC-Troubleshooting-and-Optimization-Guide"][u]PC Troubleshooting Guide[/u][/url], a list of [url="https://support.borderlands.com/hc/en-us/community/topics"][u]known issues[/u][/url], or [url="https://support.borderlands.com/hc/en-us/sections/39799542385299-Tech-Tinkering-Tips"][u]browse a list of Support threads here[/u][/url].[/p][p][/p][quote][p][b]NOTE:[/b] We've received reports that some players are experiencing reduced performance after downloading this update.[/p][p][b]SOLUTION: [/b]Stuttering issues should resolve over time as the shaders continue to compile in the background while playing. If you're still experiencing issues after 15 minutes of continuous play, you can also clear your shader cache via your video card manufacturer's approved method.[/p][/quote][p][/p][h1]Change List:[/h1][p][b]Weekly Activities:[/b] [/p][list][*][p][b]Weekly Big Encore Boss[/b] has switched to a tougher variant of a different existing boss with an even more rewarding loot pool for those that take it on. [/p][/*][*][p]The[b] Weekly Wildcard Mission[/b] has changed. These Missions feature a guaranteed Legendary drop that you can repeatedly earn to get your ideal roll.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Maurice’s Black Market Vending Machine[/b] has moved to another location and changed its offerings. Remember, while the location is the same, your vending machine items are different from other players, so ask around to see if someone has the item you’re looking for![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Stability & Performance[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Improvements to stability and performance.[/p][list][*][p]Addressed various instances of hitching, low FPS, and crashes. [/p][/*][*][p]We are continuing to investigate and will make further improvements to stability and performance.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Updated character animations for performance improvements.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Graphics Preset could be set to High or Very High when using Run Auto-Detect in Visual Menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed rare issues of infinite loading screens during crossplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved loading of characters in menus to reduce visible delays when entering character select.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Rewards & This will be addressed in an upcoming update.  [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Updated Class Mods to prevent them from dropping with incorrect skill points.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the ECHO log "Maurice's Log" as a requirement for the challenge ”Kairos Speaks“.[/p][list][*][p]Note: For those not seeing the reward after this change, we will be addressing that in a future patch.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Vault Hunter Changes[/b][/h2][h3]Harlowe the Gravitar[/h3][list][*][p][b]Gravitar[/b] [i]Ground State [/i]Capstone has been corrected to remove inaccurate verbiage about enemies taking reduced damage when they do not.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gravitar[/b] [i]Flux Generator[/i] no longer heals enemies with [i]Potential Transference[/i] Capstone. [/p][/*][*][p]Updated [b]Gravitar[/b] [i]Accretion[/i] passive to consistently grant Lifesteal to allies. [/p][/*][*][p]Addressed various reported issues with [b]Gravitar [/b]Unstable Energy[i] [/i]Pocket created from [i]CHROMA Accelerator[/i] Action Skill.[/p][list][*][p] Includes instances where it would not disappear properly, convert to Cryo Damage, or split as intended with certain skill tree combinations. notes.title: Borderlands 4 Has Been Delayed On Nintendo Switch 2 Amid Ongoing Performance Issues
notes.content:
Borderlands 4 has had a successful launch on Xbox, PC, and PS5, but just 10 days out from its Nintendo Switch 2 launch, it has been delayed indefinitely.

The immensely popular looter-shooter, Borderlands 4, launched earlier this month to widespread acclaim. Many reviews touted the title as a ‘return to form,’ with the median critical score on Metacritic hitting 82 percent. However, fans have recently flooded the lane with bad scores, claiming the title has poor performance regardless of console or gaming rig.

Over on Steam, what was once read as a “positive” reception has changed to mixed due to performance issues fans are having, and they’re voicing the issues that are occurring. Potentially due to the current performance issues on PS5, Xbox, and PC, Gearbox has decided to outright delay the Nintendo Switch 2 port for Borderlands 4 indefinitely, with Nintendo rolling out refunds for pre-orders. The delay post can be seen below from the official... Read more

notes.title: Best Borderlands 4 settings for optimized PC performance
notes.content:
Finding the best Borderlands 4 settings for PC is a tricky job right now, as the game is in an ongoing battle with performance issues across all platforms. You may well be struggling to achieve a stable frame rate even if you have the best graphics card from our buying guide installed in your gaming PC.

The Borderlands 4 system requirements aren't unreasonably high, but players with gaming PCs of all levels are struggling to get good performance in Gearbox's latest looter shooter. That includes us, as during our first Borderlands 4 test, we found that our rig performed poorly, failing to hit an average of 60fps with 45fps 1% lows at 1080p or 1440p when using the medium graphics preset and DLSS upscaling. However, a new Borderlands 4 update has been deployed, and while it doesn't bring a magic fix for performance, there are some minor improvements that are a step in the right direction.

notes.title: THIS WEEK ON KAIROS
notes.content:
[p]Hey Vault Hunters! Welcome to “This Week on Kairos” - a weekly post where we share everything happening across the world of [i]Borderlands 4[/i], from developer updates to community highlights and beyond.[/p][p]Every Friday, we’ll be here with the latest news, fan creations, dev spotlights, helpful resources, and anything else we think you’ll want to see. Whether you're looking to catch up, dive deeper, or just see what your fellow players are up to, this is the place.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/f72c8de5831f110f20bd4f2bca5015e923864647.png"][/img][/p][h3]Our Latest Update:[/h3][p]We’ve rolled out several updates since launch, with more coming soon. Here’s what you may have missed:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/1285190/announcements/detail/534361794856092912"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]A guide on how to submit a ticket can be found here: [/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/1285190/discussions/2/673972930559959886/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/1285190/discussions/2/673972930559959886/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]When you submit a ticket, please remember to attach your DxDiag or MSinfo file. If you need assistance with doing that, here’s a walkthrough:[/p][p][url="https://support.borderlands.com/hc/en-us/articles/44564441894291-PC-How-do-I-attach-a-DxDiag-and-MSinfo-file"]https://support.borderlands.com/hc/en-us/articles/44564441894291-PC-How-do-I-attach-a-DxDiag-and-MSinfo-file[/url][/p][p]
[/p][h3][i]Borderlands[/i] Support Hub[/h3][p]If you’re experiencing issues, a lot of potential resolutions can be found in the guides listed on our Support pages within Steam Discussions and our website. There are also some tips and tricks for things related to gameplay, accessibility, and troubleshooting.[/p][p][/p][p]If none of these guides have helped yet, don’t worry! Submit a ticket with us - we are continuing to field each one in an effort to give players the best possible experience.[/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/1285190/discussions/2/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/1285190/discussions/2/[/url][/p][p][url="https://support.borderlands.com/hc/en-us/categories/39763360813843"]https://support.borderlands.com/hc/en-us/categories/39763360813843[/url][/p][p]
[/p][h3]You Broke Free![/h3][p]This week, we released a SHiFT code for our “Break Free Pack,” so if you haven’t gotten it already, log onto your SHiFT account and redeem it![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1285190/view/679602429802579039"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3]Cosmetic Items - So You Can Feel Bonita[/h3][p]We’ve rolled out several different cosmetic items this past week and compiled all the existing offers into one super-mega-official-beautiful list for you! Claim them all, sugar![/p][p][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/news/cosmetic-item-offers/"]https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/news/cosmetic-item-offers/[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Community Hub Update[/h3][p]We added some really cool 3D-print files through our partnership with Printables, and they are now available for everyone on our Community Hub! Keep this page handy - we’ll be updating it in the weeks to come![/p][p][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/community/"]https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/community/[/url][/p][p]
[/p][h3]A Note For Our Players[/h3][p]On Wednesday, we posted this announcement on our socials and Steam, keeping you all in the loop about our top priorities. We appreciate all of the feedback we’ve been getting![/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/1285190/eventcomments/600789889375651303/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/1285190/eventcomments/600789889375651303/[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/4a7b4209af0cb8e2490bbd711cef5dc0e3d607b7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Steam Community Screenshots[/h3][p]As you take screenshots and drop them in Steam, we’ll round up a few of our favorites for your viewing pleasure. Enjoy the beauty of chaos - er, I mean, Kairos![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3567965356"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3568396192"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3566508656"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3569635277"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/8fb96d3607a8c746d71170c41f4f49a7cb5b5dbd.png"][/img][/p][h3]Behind the Team: Allison Mann, [i]Borderlands 4[/i] Senior Manager for Game Capture[/h3][p]Every week, we’re spotlighting one of the minds behind the mayhem. You’ll get to learn about folks from both Gearbox and 2K, and how each person who touches the game both influences and is influenced by [i]Borderlands 4[/i]. This week, we're talking with [b]Allison Mann[/b], 2K’s Senior Manager for Game Capture[b]:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s your philosophy when it comes to showing gameplay in the best light?[/b][/p][p]Gameplay capture is all about making the game look the most fun it can possibly be. My biggest philosophy when capturing is to make the game look how [i]you feel [/i]when you're playing it for yourself. This means heightening cinematic moments, creating smooth transitions from one action to the next, while also staying authentic to the game's tone and gameplay loop. It's like the ultimate gamer wish fulfillment![/p][p][/p][p][b]How do you handle situations where what looks fun to play isn’t always easy to show on camera?[/b][/p][p]This is one of the trickiest challenges with game capture, and we employ a couple of tools to get around obstacles like these. Lighting a scene, adjusting the camera angle, changing an enemy type, or using a different location all contribute to getting a great shot. We try to keep every moment fun while also communicating what we want to show the player. Say we need to capture a unique weapon that feels fun to play - showing a detailed close-up of the weapon and then cutting to a high-energy combat gameplay shot keeps the action flowing and emphasizes the fun, while also communicating the features of the weapon to the player without compromising any visuals.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What advice would you give to someone who is interested in working in game capture?[/b][/p][p]Play lots of video games! Seriously, being a gamer is probably the biggest requirement for getting into game capture. Understanding how to play video games, what good gameplay should look like, and understanding what players expect in games are all essential to marketing them. This is one of those few jobs in game marketing where you are expected to play the game every day! ;) Additionally, having an educational background in visual art, film/TV, or game development will definitely set you ahead. At the end of the day, everyone in game capture is a gamer at heart. We love playing video games, and we love making them look cool as hell.[/p][p]
[/p][h3]Community Creative Corner[/h3][p]Our community members aren’t just gamers—many of you are also artists. Whether it’s cosplay, digital art, or some yet-to-be-invented medium, we’re your biggest fans. Check out this week’s hand-picked fan creations:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/78c5ca7a39f2226158ccaa037d86909e320d5f80.jpg"][/img][url="https://www.tumblr.com/lalinoire"][u][i]- lalinoire[/i][/u][/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/41c57fd9b40ac600b619936694a53e7d819d4b12.png"][/img][url="https://www.tumblr.com/vishantiescape"][u][i]- vishantiescape[/i][/u][/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/c8a4dc270d642950a3e453a8a3862658a538c454.jpg"][/img][url="https://www.tumblr.com/sufroyo"][u][i]- sufroyo[/i][/u][/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/03fac58a5b167c6b4b9e2acddebab532de13f6c6.png"][/img][/p][p]That’s it for this week—with more updates, more chaos, and maybe a few surprises coming next Friday. Until then: keep your ECHOnet tuned and your loot luck high.[/p][p]Happy Hunting,
[b]The Borderlands Team[/b][/p][p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/cab2860dd2091c9cc501e726e1b96f9a4579849a.png"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1285190/Borderlands_4/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]

notes.title: I tested Borderlands 4 on an RTX 4070, and sorry Randy, but it runs really badly
notes.content:
While it's now far from uncommon for a game to struggle with performance issues at launch, Borderlands 4 finds itself in a unique position. This is because, rather than developer Gearbox committing to just fixing the reported issues, its CEO, Randy Pitchford, is busy making bold claims about gamers and PC hardware on social media, while also using customer service data to deny that the issue is widespread.

Well, I finally had the chance to give Borderlands 4 a go on PC using our RTX 4070 testing rig, which we use to benchmark all the latest releases, and my experience was far from positive. Taking Randy's claims about gamers expecting to run super high graphics on low-spec PCs into consideration, I only ran the game on the medium graphics preset, while presenting my data and general experience. Our rig may not use the best graphics card or CPU, but it's still a very capable gaming PC, often running the latest releases at the high preset with decent frame rates at 1080p and 1440p.

notes.title: Borderlands 4 review
notes.content:
While everyone complains about the technical state that Borderlands 4 released in, whether it’s choppy performance or the lack of an FOV slider on consoles, I found myself on the much happier end of the spectrum. Aside from the gruellingly slow start, where I was drowning in weak pistols and absolutely no other weapon types, playing this game had me smiling like an idiot about how it’s the best Borderlands yet.

Admittedly, it’s a series I’ve never really clicked with, all previous attempts having ended in boredom. Borderlands 4, though, is different. Almost everything about it, from the world design to the power variety of the playable Vault Hunters, has been improved or refined, to the point where I’m actually annoyed that I have to stop playing so that I can write up this review. This game is consuming me.

notes.title: Pitchford says Borderlands 4 is for "premium gamers" after performance backlash
notes.content:
Borderlands 4 has a lot to prove. The series' third instalment wasn't exactly to everyone's liking, and while I enjoyed Dungeons and Dragon-inspired spinoff Tiny Tina's Wonderlands, it was ultimately a fun, fleeting diversion rather than a full sequel. And that's without mentioning the absolutely diabolical movie, which currently sits at a harrowing 10% on Rotten Tomatoes. Ouch. At first glance, however, Borderlands 4 looked like it could be the turning point for Gearbox's looter shooter franchise, but as players have poured in and began to explore Kairos, they've encountered myriad performance issues, hence the 67% rating on Steam.

notes.title: Borderlands 4 Partners With Prusa for Day-One 3D Printable Files
notes.content:
Borderlands 4 fans can now hold the chaos in their hands, as Prusa and Gearbox release downloadable prop files on launch day.

Prusa Research is bridging the digital divide for gamers and makers with the release of official 3D printable files for Borderlands 4 on Printables.com, developed in partnership with Gearbox Software and publisher 2K Games. The launch marks one of the first times in gaming history that fans can download and print game-accurate props the same day a major title reaches shelves. It is a milestone for cosplay enthusiasts and the wider maker community, and after all, who would not want the ability to print their own props?

Iconic items such as the Psycho and Ripper masks, detailed weapon replicas, and finely crafted cosplay components are now available as free downloads, with every model apparently tested on Prusa’s lineup of 3D printers. notes.title: New Borderlands 4 update brings stability improvements "for a wide range of PCs"
notes.content:
A new Borderlands 4 update today offers developer Gearbox's first salvo at tackling the performance complaints for the PC version of its long-awaited looter shooter. If you've been playing as much as I have, you've likely encountered texture pop-in, lag, frame rate drops, crashes, or other issues. This BL4 patch is the first post-launch attempt to solve those problems, and while it's unlikely everything will be ironed out immediately, it feels like a step in the right direction for me. Alongside this, Gearbox has also added two more free skins to its release-weekend rewards.

notes.title: Borderlands 4's vanishing world bosses are its most baffling design decision
notes.content:
It's early days, but I'm having a great time with Borderlands 4 so far. The UE5 performance struggles are agonizing, but ever since I was able to lock in settings that worked, I've felt an increasingly broad smile spreading across my face the more I play. At its heart, it reminds me of my true series love, the 2009 original, especially in its early areas. But Gearbox has clearly picked and chosen some of the best bits of every entry, including Tiny Tina's Wonderlands, and the result is something I can see myself playing for a long, long time to come. There's just one big frustration right now: its mysteriously disappearing world bosses.

notes.title: THIS WEEK ON KAIROS
notes.content:
[p]Hey Vault Hunters! Welcome to “This Week on Kairos” - a weekly post where we share everything happening across the world of [i]Borderlands 4[/i], from developer updates to community highlights and beyond.[/p][p]Every Friday, we’ll be here with the latest news, fan creations, dev spotlights, helpful resources, and anything else we think you’ll want to see. Whether you're looking to catch up, dive deeper, or just see what your fellow players are up to, this is the place.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/1ac8af64c921b9f8d4366cd8d0041e552a892963.png"][/img][/p][h3]IT’S HERE! WE HAVE ARRIVED![/h3][p][i]Borderlands 4[/i] is now LIVE! It’s time for mayhem. It’s time for big loot, bigger explosions, and a whole lot of chaos. It’s time to take on the Timekeeper solo or teamed up with friends. Whether you’re going to be a frontline fighter, a hawkeye from afar, a raging fist, a demolition aficionado, a master of the macabre, or are just here for a good time with your big purple cat, remember: we're all Vault Hunters and in this together.[/p][p][/p][p]From both Gearbox and 2K: thank you from the bottom of our hearts. From seasoned veterans to first-time Action Skill users, we are all so excited to share the next big adventure in the [i]Borderlands[/i] universe. We couldn’t have arrived at this point without you, and we can’t wait to join you on Kairos.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="NtSRtcXcCnk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Ctrl, SHiFT, Play: Your SHiFT User Guide Awaits[/h3][p]Are you ready for all the redemptions and rewards in [i]Borderlands 4[/i]? Make sure you have your SHiFT Account set up and SHiFT codes ready. Have questions? We got you covered:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/1285190/announcements/detail/535487059416056058"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3]PC Specs and Features Breakdown[/h3][p]Harlowe isn’t the only Vault Hunter with a knack for tech - we know that's you, too! Make sure your rig is equipped (and your drivers are updated) to dive into Kairos on day one. In addition to a breakdown of minimum and recommended PC Specs, an overview of accessibility features is also included in this article:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/1285190/announcements/detail/543367724371282265"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3]Quick Tips Guide[/h3][p]Vault Hunters read the instruction manual! We created a guide with some helpful, spoiler-free tips and tricks to aid you in your mission to take down the Timekeeper:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1285190/view/535487059416056103"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3]The Players Have Spoken![/h3][p]As reviews come in, we love watching and reading all of your thoughts on the game. From quality-of-life changes to the beauty of Kairos to squadding up with your friends - your feedback on everything matters, and we are so grateful to receive it! Here are just a few things people are saying:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S5_CzXrkP9E"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AQCHyTdb_mc"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ABFlovaCTtM"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]“Return of the king.” - [url="https://screenrant.com/borderlands-4-review/"][u][i]Screenrant[/i][/u][/url][/h3][h3]“The looter shooter crown has been reclaimed.” - [url="https://www.destructoid.com/reviews/borderlands-4-review/"][u][i]Destructoid[/i][/u][/url][/h3][h3]“Best shooter I've played in 2025.” - [url="https://www.gamesradar.com/games/borderlands/borderlands-4-review/"][u][i]Gamesradar+[/i][/u][/url][/h3][p][/p][p]"Feels like BL2 again, and I’m loving it. Tons of quests and side quests and side-side quests, loot everywhere, and just plain fun." - [url="https://steamcommunity.com/id/HoosfoosMcCave/recommended/1285190/"][u]HoosfoosMcCave[/u][/url][/p][p]"Game is fun, lots of cool new mobility, gun variety is cool. Feels like Borderlands." - [url="https://steamcommunity.com/id/Screamoguitar/recommended/1285190"][u]Screamo[/u][/url][/p][p]"Borderlands 3 gave us guns with legs. Borderlands 4 just gave me a gun that walked out on me. My dad would be proud." - [url="https://steamcommunity.com/id/JinnXV/recommended/1285190/"][u]Jinn[/u][/url][/p][p]"You can mute Claptrap 10/10" - [url="https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199307237694/recommended/1285190/"][u]penguin[/u][/url][/p][p]"Amazing. Borderlands is back, and it's an amazing job they have done listening to the feedback." - [url="https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561197997691433/recommended/1285190/"][u]Avid_Gamer[/u][/url][/p][p]"im having fun shooting things! you can have fun shooting things!" - [url="https://steamcommunity.com/id/Niige/recommended/1285190/"][u]karpachino[/u][/url][/p][p]"It took SO much willpower to put the game down tonight. 10/10" - [url="https://steamcommunity.com/id/Tavinyl/recommended/1285190/"][u]Tavinyl[/u][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Steam Community Screenshots[/h3][p]As you take screenshots and drop them in Steam, we’ll round up a few of our favorites for your viewing pleasure. Enjoy the beauty of chaos - erI mean, Kairos![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3566426055"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3566451841"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3566402683"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3566645070"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]Get Your Break Free Pack![/h3][p]Already we've seen so much amazing looter shooter action from the community! Clearly you've all embraced the spirit of breaking free from the oppressive Timekeeper - but we want to see just how unstoppable you Vault Hunters truly are.[/p][p]From September 12 to 14, we'll be behind the scenes monitoring the unbridled carnage you're unleashing on Kairos. If [i]Borderlands 4[/i] players across all platforms can gather their friends and collectively cause enough Mayhem, we'll serve up a SHiFT code for the Break Free Pack, containing 1 Vault Hunter Skin usable by Vex, Rafa, Amon, and Harlowe, and 1 Legendary Ripper Shield, scales to your Vault Hunter level when redeemed (with a minimum of Lvl 25).[/p][p]Time starts now, so get out there and chip in along with the rest of the [i]Borderlands 4[/i] community![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/8fb96d3607a8c746d71170c41f4f49a7cb5b5dbd.png"][/img][/p][h3]Behind the Team: Anthony Nicholson, [i]Borderlands 4[/i] Senior Project Producer[/h3][p]Every week, we’re spotlighting one of the minds behind the mayhem. You’ll get to learn about folks from both Gearbox and 2K, and how each person who touches the game both influences and is influenced by [i]Borderlands 4[/i]. This week, we're talking with [b]Anthony Nicholson[/b], Gearbox’s Senior Project Producer[b]:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s something fans might not realize producers do behind the scenes?[/b][/p][p]I think people may not realize how versatile producers are. The main objective is to stay on time, on budget, and keep the content creation flowing smoothly, but I have several producers on my team that are more than that. Be it importing art assets, creating VFX, debugging code, writing side missions, or creating test maps and analyzing bugs, producers are a versatile bunch with a holistic view of the product. Personally through my time here, I have designed characters and a boss fight, put on the suit for mocap acting, and, near the end of the projects, help in directing trailers and demos for the public to get excited about, to name a few. A good producer uses their passion to influence and motivate their department and their game in many big ways.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Can you talk about how community feedback makes its way into your team’s workflow?[/b][/p][p]Whether it is feedback we have seen from a previous title or, for folks like myself, engaging with the community socially, we care about their thoughts and feedback because we build everything with a “player first” mentality. It is important that we are delivering on what we feel is best for the player by [i]listening to[/i] the player, so though we may not act on every single suggestion, we weigh it and put great thought into the solution to create an experience that they will appreciate and love.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Outside of work, what’s a hobby or passion that helps you recharge?[/b][/p][p]I really love cooking, coaching, and of course playing games! I think each of my hobbies taps into my core being of wanting to create, so with anything that lets me explore new ideas or make something new, I'm always excited to jump into and see what I can come up with.[/p][p]
[/p][h3]Community Creative Corner[/h3][p]Our community members aren’t just gamers—many of you are also artists. Whether it’s cosplay, digital art, or some yet-to-be-invented medium, we’re your biggest fans. Check out this week’s hand-picked fan creations:[/p][p]First, [i]Borderlands[/i] fan and musician Anthony Garone sits down with [i]Borderlands 4 [/i]composer Joshua Carro to talk about the making of the soundtrack. This is definitely worth a watch. [/p][previewyoutube="YSpLM52Lb9A;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]On this special Launch Day issue, we’d like to celebrate the heroic Vault Hunters both in the [i]Borderlands[/i] universe and among our community. We can’t wait to see all of the incredible fan art that comes out in the future, and we’re going to start by showcasing some past works of the characters you’ve loved so far:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/5914b92cbe3d0d7c925e58b5aa2c324e1fbce57d.jpg"][/img][url="https://www.tumblr.com/suchscary"][u][i]Suchscary[/i][/u][/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/c7e6da9c5ec968f2ecd1a27e50b25a3a0d8bb4fa.png"][/img][url="https://pirek.carrd.co/"][u][i]Pirek[/i][/u][/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/fa119e0d360e0a6aaaa8ee41c444c63340c44f95.jpg"][/img][url="https://www.tumblr.com/jugumpuppet"][u][i]Jugumpuppet[/i][/u][/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/1dc4e333deb2bd7cf08eea2866c9f28d8734d6cb.jpg"][/img][url="https://www.tumblr.com/souls-699"][u][i]Souls_699[/i][/u][/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/3eb983867a8afaee766c69b0e8e47126b05a0d15.png"][/img][/p][p]That’s it for this week—more updates, more chaos, and maybe a few surprises coming next Friday. Until then: keep your ECHOnet tuned and your loot luck high.[/p][p]Happy Hunting,
[b]The Borderlands Team[/b][/p][p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/cab2860dd2091c9cc501e726e1b96f9a4579849a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1285190/Borderlands_4/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]

notes.title: Borderlands 4 is the lowest rated game in the series on Steam, kind of
notes.content:
I keep accidentally typing Borederlands 4 instead of Borderlands 4. That has no bearing on the actual game-which by all accounts is actually pretty fun once you get past all the bugs-but I thought it was a funny coincidence seeing as Gearbox's iconic FPS game has dropped to a 'mixed' rating on Steam. This makes Borderlands 4 (spelled it right that time) the worst-rated game in the main series, at least if we're not counting spin-offs.

notes.content:

notes.title: Borderlands 4 is here at last, and it's a make-or-break moment for the series
notes.content:
Borderlands 4 is here, and I'm actually quite excited. I fell in love with Gearbox's looter-shooter series back in my university dorm room in 2009, and I've continued to have an affinity for it ever since. The new installment has a lot to prove, to me and the wider audience; BL3 played really well at its core, but it was badly paced and its brand of in-your-face humor fell flatter than it had in the past. Perhaps this once-great name had run out of steam? Borderlands 4 restarts the engine, and takes things in a slightly new direction - but will it be enough to win hearts and minds once more?

How do you reset your skills in Borderlands 4? In Borderlands 4, you earn skill points as you level up your vault hunter, allowing you to invest in your favorite skills to make them stronger. Fortunately, there's a way to reset all of your skills in Borderlands 4, but it does come at a cost. This will make getting through the co-op game much easier, giving you everything you need to secure Borderlands 4 legendary weapons to become even stronger.

Borderlands 4 might be struggling on PC, according to some early impressions from those playing the game. One video in particular shows the game struggling to hit 70fps in some areas on a rig equipped with an Nvidia GeForce RTX 5090 and AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D.

While the Borderlands 4 system requirements don't exactly demand the best graphics card from our buying guide, they did sit on the high side for a modern 3D game. The artwork in Borderlands 4 might look cartoony, but just like Doom The Dark Ages, it still requires a decent amount of GPU horsepower.

notes.title: Borderlands 4 Quick Tips
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/06f11bf2134215227782f424641eabed9f626ae1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Welcome to Kairos, Vault Hunters! [i]Borderlands 4 [/i]is available now—and as you, your co-op partners, and the rest of the Crimson Resistance get ready to undertake your mission to topple the Timekeeper's reign, check out this list of spoiler-free tips to help you loot and shoot to the fullest.[/p][p][/p][p]If you'd prefer to start by getting a sense for what awaits on this mysterious, hidden planet, you can get a general overview on the [url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/"][u][i]Borderlands 4 [/i][/u][/url][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/"][u]Game Info[/u][/url] page, dive right into theorycrafting the perfect builds for [url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/vex/"][u]Vex[/u][/url], [url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/rafa/"][u]Rafa[/u][/url], [url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/amon/"][u]Amon[/u][/url], or [url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/harlowe/"][u]Harlowe[/u][/url] via their Vault Hunter pages, or [url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/news/meet-the-voice-cast/"][u]meet the talented actors[/u][/url] behind each of their English-language voice performances! [/p][p][/p][h2]Remember to use your Repkit when taking damage[/h2][p]Whether you're running low on health or just need a temporary buff to survive a firefight, don't forget to take full advantage of your Repkit. Along with instant restoration of some health points and an additional amount of regeneration over time, Repkits can provide helpful survivability boosts like reducing incoming damage for a short duration. Just keep an eye on its cooldown in the lower-left corner of your HUD and remember there's no downside to triggering it as often as you might need.[/p][p][/p][h2]Utilize your Ordnance as often as possible[/h2][p]In [i]Borderlands 4[/i], the new Ordnance slot is where you can equip your hardest-hitting munitions, including different types of Grenades and Heavy Weapons like rocket launchers, massively powerful machine guns, and colossal energy cannons. Unlike previous [i]Borderlands [/i]games, these don't consume ammo and can be activated any time they're off cooldown! To maximize your damage output, let that Ordnance fly as often as possible to make short work of the opposition![/p][p][/p][h2]Use your movement abilities to dodge incoming attacks[/h2][p][i]Borderlands 4[/i]'s Vault Hunters can move like never before, darting around the battlefield by double jumping, gliding, dodging, grappling, and more. Dodging is especially important during boss fights, as incoming damage will be especially dangerous—but a lateral dash or a quick double-jump can get you out of harm's way without interrupting your barrage of bullets![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/03c6c45aa5a8f002e56ea49f5218c9258af28066.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Use elemental damage to tear through enemies[/h2][p]Elemental damage types are among the most common modifiers you'll find on the bazillions of guns in [i]Borderlands 4[/i]. At the most basic level, all guns can deal six types of damage: Kinetic, Incendiary, Shock, Corrosive, Cryo, and Radiation.[/p][p][/p][p]Think of Kinetic Damage as the baseline, as it will deal the same amount of hurt to enemies regardless of their type. But properly matching elemental damage types against the different kinds of enemies you'll encounter can give you a big boost in lethality. Note that minding elemental types is less important if you're playing on Easy difficulty, and extremely important if you're playing on Hard difficulty (which is the default for the [url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/news/endgame-overview/"][u]endgame Ultimate Vault Hunter Mode[/u][/url]) where enemies have tougher elemental resistances but are more susceptible to their elemental weakness.[/p][list][*][p][b]Incendiary is most effective against enemies with red health bars denoting Bio.[/b] Burn your targets with damage over time until ashes are all that's left.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shock damage is most effective against enemies with blue health bars denoting Shield.[/b] Stun these shielded hostiles into submission with the voltage of Shock. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Corrosive damage is most effective against enemies with yellow health bars denoting Armor.[/b] Melt through your opponents' defenses and disintegrate their hopes of survival.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Radiation damage causes enemies to explode and is also effective against enemies with blue health bars denoting Shield[/b], albeit slightly less so than Shock. Blasting a barrage of Radiation is excellent for taking out large groups, as it deals damage over time in an area and makes affected enemies violently explode when killed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cryo damage can freeze enemies and is also effective against enemies with yellow health bars denoting Armor[/b], albeit slightly less so than Corrosive. This chilling damage is ideal against tanky targets: freezing tougher enemies will make them lose health over time relative to their maximum HP.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Reclaim Silos to aid your search for Vault Key Fragments[/h2][p]From Order patrols to world bosses, there’s always something to shoot and loot as you explore Kairos. You'll also come across short gameplay experiences and new activities that auto-grant a tracked mission whenever you discover them—like Silos, which house old, decommissioned Order tech that you can hijack for the Crimson Resistance with the help of your ECHO-4.[/p][p][/p][p]Once you've reclaimed a Silo, it will reveal the approximate location of a Vault Key Fragment. Reclaimed Silos release a hacked communications balloon that you can zipline up to start gliding through the air towards your next objective, and they can also be used as Fast Travel points![/p][p][/p][h2]Collect Vault Key Fragments to open Primordial Vaults[/h2][p]Through exploring and treasure-hunting, you'll eventually track down enough Vault Key Fragments to assemble your very own Vault Key. From there, you'll need to track down what the Vault Key was made for: opening the gates to a Primordial Vault, a high-level dungeon hidden within that region of Kairos. Be ready for a challenge when you open a Primordial Vault... and the possibility of extremely powerful loot if you prevail. Completing the Vaults also improves your glide pack, which is a hugely impactful reward for overcoming these difficult dungeons.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/f65e78fbe5dedd4a1478992bad2ec96e6dc2fa57.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Seek out side missions for extra rewards[/h2][p]It's always fun getting to customize your Vault Hunter's look with cosmetic items that match your personal style, and some of the most prestigious cosmetics can be earned simply by completing side missions on Kairos. Of course, you'll also get bonus cash and typically some new loot, along with additional XP to level up faster and unlock those new skill points that'll further strengthen your Vault Hunter's build! New side missions become available as you explore Kairos and complete more of the main campaign, so be sure to check your map frequently for newly available side missions in your search for added rewards.[/p][p][/p][h2]Don't be afraid to alternate between solo and co-op play[/h2][p][i]Borderlands [/i]has always been known for its best-in-class support of both solo and co-op play, and [i]Borderlands 4 [/i]makes freely switching between them more accessible and seamless than ever. You can expect the same drop-in/drop-out, individually balanced multiplayer experience, and progress made in another player's game will be recognized upon loading back into your own (with the option to skip the content you've already played, if you'd like). [/p][p][/p][p]Along with vital quality-of-life features like these, plus other new additions like full co-op party participation in cutscenes, read on below to learn how else it's easier than ever to team up with other Vault Hunters while looting and shooting across Kairos.[/p][p][/p][h2]Reunite with teammates instantly using Fast Travel[/h2][p]Along with the standard option of using Fast Travel to teleport to hub areas and any discovered waypoints, you'll also have the option to Fast Travel directly to other players, which can be extremely helpful when navigating [i]Borderlands 4[/i]'s huge, seamless world. [url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/#world"][u]The regions of the dangerous new planet Kairos[/u][/url] interconnect to create the biggest expanse ever in a [i]Borderlands[/i] game, and you might end up exploring in a totally different direction than your co-op party. [/p][p][/p][p]The fact that you can cruise around on your personalized Digirunner vehicle at any time, along with the new layer of verticality in the environments, makes it so that you might inadvertently put a lot of distance between you and your squad. With party-based Fast Travel, you can almost instantly join back up after a joyride in the opposite direction or a flubbed jump off the side of a cliff.[/p][p][/p][h2]Configure crossplay with the Sessions Settings on the main menu[/h2][p]First, select the Session Settings button in [i]Borderlands 4[/i]'s main menu and set your preferred Party Privacy option, whether that's Friends Only, Invite Only, Public, or Local Only. Then, toggle Personal Crossplay on or off to decide whether you'll allow players from other platforms into your party. Please note that if anyone in your party has this toggled off, the whole party will have crossplay disabled for that session.[/p][p][/p][p]The Session Settings menu is also where you can set your individualized Difficulty level, which will scale appropriately so that everyone in your multiplayer party can make things as forgiving or challenging as they like without affecting their co-op partners' games.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]With these quick tips and your badass Vault Hunter skills, you're ready to take on the Timekeeper and collect tons of Legendary loot in the process. Whether you savor your adventure on Kairos or race towards the [url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/news/endgame-overview/"][u]endgame[/u][/url] as fast as possible, be sure to check out our robust [url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/news/post-launch-roadmap/"][u]Post-Launch Roadmap[/u][/url], which includes paid and free content packed with new loot, story content, and so much more. We'll see you on Kairos, Vault Hunter![/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1285190/Borderlands_4/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Borderlands 4 (PC) Review
notes.content:
With a franchise like Borderlands hitting its fifteenth anniversary and sixth game, there is always the worry that the series has run its course. The longer it goes, the more tiresome the repeated characters or jokes, gameplay, and writing can be. At some point, you start wondering if they can actually keep surprising you, or if they’re just coasting on old ideas with a new coat of paint. With Borderlands 3, I’ll admit, I was starting to worry we’d hit that wall. The guns still felt good, the loot loop was starting to become a problem with the balancing of drops seemingly way off, and the chaos was pure Borderlands, but something felt off about it.

The pacing dragged, the jokes didn’t always land, and were overly cringy, and the villains were the weakest of the bunch we have had. They never once felt like they earned the attention they demanded. I had fun playing it, really, but it didn’t feel like the step forward the series needed. It was loud, sure, but not sharp. Big, but... Read more

notes.title: Borderlands 4 SHiFT User Guide
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/7550110db126fab57f758746122e2cd3121bba39.jpg"][/img][/p][p]To enhance your looter shooter adventures on Kairos in [i]Borderlands 4[/i], you'll want to [u][url="https://shift.gearboxsoftware.com/"]sign up for a free SHiFT Account[/url][/u] if you don't have one already! Gearbox's SHiFT platform powers the online matchmaking and crossplay multiplayer of [i]Borderlands 4[/i], and it's also the method for redeeming all those highly coveted SHiFT codes and their associated rewards![/p][p]Creating a SHiFT Account is simple, but we've assembled these quick tips that'll ensure you're set up to have the best experience while you wreak havoc on Kairos. If you run into any issues related to SHiFT, you can [u][url="https://support.borderlands.com/hc/en-us/requests/new?ticket_form_id=32130122043795"]contact 2K Support here[/url][/u] for assistance.[/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]What is SHiFT? What are SHiFT codes?[/b][/h3][p]SHiFT is an account system integrated into [i]Borderlands 4 [/i]and other [i]Borderlands [/i]titles. SHiFT Accounts are free, and are also used to redeem in-game rewards by entering SHiFT codes, which are typically available for a limited time. SHiFT codes are used to redeem in-game rewards such as Golden Keys, which can then be used to obtain rare loot![/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]Sign up for a free SHiFT Account[/b][/h3][p]It's easy to sign up for a free SHiFT Account on the [u][url="https://shift.gearboxsoftware.com/"]official Gearbox SHiFT site[/url][/u], using an email account or a first-party platform account (Steam, Xbox, PlayStation, Epic Games, etc). Once you've created a SHiFT Account and signed in, you can link any platforms you'll use to play [i]Borderlands 4 [/i](or any other [i]Borderlands [/i]games) to your SHiFT Account.[/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]What happens if I enter my SHiFT Account age incorrectly?[/b][/h3][p]If you enter your age incorrectly, you will need to [u][url="https://support.borderlands.com/hc/en-us/requests/new?ticket_form_id=32130122043795"]contact 2K Support[/url][/u] for assistance.[/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]How to link your SHiFT Accounts to your platform account(s)[/b][/h3][p]Sign into your [u][url="https://shift.gearboxsoftware.com/account"]SHiFT Account[/url][/u], navigate to "Gaming Platforms" and click "Sign In" for any platform account you want linked to your SHiFT Account.[/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]How to claim SHiFT codes and rewards[/b][/h3][p]SHiFT codes can be redeemed for your SHiFT Account on the [u][url="https://shift.gearboxsoftware.com/"]Gearbox SHiFT site[/url][/u] in the Rewards tab, or via the in-game SHiFT menu within [i]Borderlands 4[/i] on the Rewards tab. Each code may be redeemed once (1) per SHiFT account. Remember, SHiFT codes are often time-limited, so try to redeem the SHiFT codes you see on our social channels ASAP![/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]How to set up an online multiplayer squad with SHiFT[/b][/h3][p]First, select the Session Settings button in [i]Borderlands 4[/i]'s main menu and set your preferred Party Privacy option, whether that's Friends Only, Invite Only, Public, or Local Only. You can join or invite other players who are on your friends list of your first-party platform account. When grouping up via crossplay, SHiFT is what allows you to search or manage your cross-platform friends list.[/p][p]If you want to squad up with cross-platform friends, make sure they're added to your Friends list by clicking the SHiFT option in the main menu, navigating to the Friends tab, and searching for the full SHiFT display name of anyone you haven't added yet. Once you have, they should show up under Friends in the upper-right of the game's main menu.[/p][p]You can add them to your party from there, or if you'd prefer, invite any friends associated with your platform account you don't see listed. Click the left-most button above your Party list in the top right of the screen and enter their first-party platform username into the search bar. [/p][p]Once they've joined, you can enter Matchmaking together or jump right into the action via Continue or New Game! [/p][p][/p][h3][b]How to join in-game Matchmaking and crossplay in [i]Borderlands 4[/i][/b][/h3][p]Before you begin Matchmaking, ensure you've followed the above steps to invite or join every friend you want in your party. Then, navigate to Session Settings in [i]Borderlands 4[/i]'s main menu to adjust Party Privacy settings if needed, and toggle Personal Crossplay on or off to decide whether you'll allow players from other platforms into your party. [b]Please note that if anyone in your party has toggled Personal Crossplay off, then the whole party will have crossplay disabled for that session.[/b][/p][p]The Session Settings menu is also where you can set your individualized Difficulty level, which will scale appropriately so that everyone in your multiplayer party can make things as forgiving or challenging as they like without affecting their co-op partners' games.[/p][p]Once you're ready to matchmake, either select the Matchmaking option from the list on the left side of the main menu screen, or click the Matchmaking button next to your Party list on the upper-right of your screen. From there, you'll have a choice between being queued into matchmaking for Campaign missions near your level of progress, Ultimate Vault Hunter mode, Moxxi's Big Encore Runs, or Weekly Wildcard missions. Keep in mind that the latter three choices can only be selected once you've completed the campaign [i]and [/i]unlocked Ultimate Vault Hunter ranks.[/p][p]Finally, select the Matchmaking playlist option you want, then hit "Begin Matchmaking" at the bottom-right of the screen and wait to be loaded into the game with your party![/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]How to link your SHiFT Account to your Twitch Account for Twitch Drop rewards*[/b][/h3][p]Sign into your [u][url="https://shift.gearboxsoftware.com/account"]SHiFT Account[/url][/u], navigate to "Gaming Platforms" and click "Sign In" under the Twitch icon. Sign in using the Twitch Account on which you will be watching the Drops streams. When viewing eligible streams, be sure you are signed in to the correct account on which you want to receive rewards.[/p][p]You can find a list of all ongoing Twitch Drops rewards campaigns on the [i][u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/twitch-drops/"]Borderlands 4[/url][/u][/i][u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/twitch-drops/"] Twitch Drops page[/url][/u], along with full details for how to earn and redeem your rewards![/p][p]


[/p][h3][b]How to get the "Hazard Pay" Weapon Skin for use in [i]Borderlands 4[/i][/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Subscribe to receive newsletters and digital marketing with a SHiFT Account using the "SIGN UP OR LOG IN" button on the [i][u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/"]Borderlands 4 [/url][/u][/i][u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/"]homepage[/url][/u]. [/p][list][*][p]If you already have a SHiFT Account, [u][url="https://shift.gearboxsoftware.com/account"]sign in via the SHiFT website[/url][/u], then scroll to the User Preferences of your Profile page and ensure that you've checked the boxes for "I would like to receive news and promotional messages from 2K and its affiliates" and "I wish to stay subscribed to the Gearbox newsletter."[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Log in on the SHiFT website, then link your preferred platform accounts under the "Gaming Platforms" tab.[/p][/*][*][p]At launch, log in with your SHiFT Account in [i]Borderlands 4[/i] to receive your exclusive Hazard Pay Weapon Skin!**[/p][/*][*][p]Whenever you receive a [i]Borderlands[/i] email, check for a SHiFT code and follow the instructions within to redeem additional rewards for your SHiFT Account![/p][/*][/olist][p]
[/p][h3][b]How to report any issues[/b][/h3][p]If you encounter any issues with your SHiFT Account, you can [u][url="https://support.borderlands.com/hc/sections/39799542385299-Tech-Tinkering-Tips"]browse the 2K Support portal for [i]Borderlands 4[/i][/url][/u] to find a solution, or [u][url="https://support.borderlands.com/hc/en-us/requests/new?ticket_form_id=32130122043795"]contact 2K Support here[/url][/u] for direct assistance. When submitting a support request, it's helpful to include the SHiFT Support ID found on your SHiFT Profile page if possible. [/p][p]
[/p][p][i]*Requires an internet connection, a Twitch Account linked to your SHiFT Account, and a SHiFT Account linked to the platform account you'll use to play Borderlands 4. Requires Borderlands 4 to redeem rewards. SHiFT Accounts are free. One redemption per SHiFT Account. Rewards will be delivered in-game once Borderlands 4 is launched and linked to the SHiFT Account used to claim the reward via Twitch. Void where prohibited. Terms apply.[/i][/p][p][i]**Requires a copy of Borderlands 4. Offer ends at 11:59 PM PT on December 31, 2030. Users must agree to the Terms of Service and opt-in to receive newsletters and digital marketing from 2K and Gearbox via a verified SHiFT Account, then log in to the verified SHiFT Account in the game to receive rewards. For SHiFT code email rewards, offer end dates will be specified in the accompanying email. In-game loot granted by Golden Keys is randomized. Please allow for up to a week to receive your in-game rewards. One redemption per SHiFT account. Void where prohibited. Terms apply. Must be 18 or older to be eligible.[/i][/p][p]

notes.title: Despite cutting the gags, Borderlands 4's PC specs say it still needs 100GB of SSD space
notes.content:
Two days before launch, Borderlands 4 has its PC system requirements. They’re generally on the higher side without teetering over into full-on tech demo lunacy – the RTX 2070 is a minimum-spec graphics card, for instance – though anyone with a smaller SSD will need to make room for the looty FPS sequel’s bumper-size 100GB storage requirement.

That means you still have time to pre-purchase to get the Gilded Glory Pack*—and we just sweetened the deal with an injection of extra loot, including four pieces of Legendary Gear and an additional Vault Hunter Head cosmetic![/p][p][/p][p]For a quick overview, here's everything included in the Gilded Glory Pack, including the new additions that will be granted to anyone who's already pre-purchased or does so before launch:[/p][list][*][p](NEW) 1 Vault Hunter Head usable by all Vault Hunters[/p][/*][*][p]1 Vault Hunter Skin usable by all Vault Hunters[/p][/*][*][p]1 Weapon Skin[/p][/*][*][p]1 ECHO-4 Drone Skin[/p][/*][*][p](NEW) 4 pieces of Legendary Gear:[/p][list][*][p](NEW) 1 Lvl 1 Legendary Maliwan SMG[/p][/*][*][p](NEW) 1 Lvl 30 Legendary Ripper Grenade[/p][/*][*][p](NEW) 1 Lvl 30 Legendary Torgue Ordnance[/p][/*][*][p](NEW) 1 Max Lvl Legendary Daedalus Assault Rifle[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][previewyoutube="9X4nyhTpC2g;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The new Vault Hunter Head, which is usable by all Vault Hunters, is a Ripper mask that lets you cosplay as one of Callis' followers! As for the four pieces of Legendary gear now added to the Gilded Glory Pack, they'll help your Vault Hunter on their climb to the level cap. Here's a quick overview of what you can expect from these killer additions to your arsenal:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Lvl 1 Legendary Maliwan SMG:[/b] Fires off spiraling projectiles to create a cone of death[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lvl 30 Legendary Ripper Grenade:[/b] Teleports through nearby enemies multiple times, dishing out damage with every bloody bounce[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lvl 30 Legendary Torgue Ordnance:[/b] Unleash a volley of high-speed rockets that ricochet in this beautiful union of Torgue and Jakobs tech[/p][/*][*][p][b]Max Lvl Legendary Daedalus Assault Rifle:[/b] Land guaranteed critical hits on enemies at full HP, with the chance to crit decreasing proportionally to their dwindling health[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Pre-purchase [i]Borderlands 4 [/i]before launch so you don't miss out on the Gilded Glory Pack before it becomes a separate purchase! notes.title: Here's the exact minute you can start playing Borderlands 4, so get ready
notes.content:
Gearbox has confirmed the exact Borderlands 4 launch times in all regions, meaning the wait to play the hotly anticipated new FPS is finally almost at an end. I've had a long history with the series; I picked up the first Borderlands on a whim, not expecting it to consume hundreds of hours of my life with its beautiful blend of shooting and looting. Since then, it's been through many incarnations, and the more I see of BL4 the more I'm starting to feel the itch to get back to the vault hunter lifestyle. Thankfully, it won't be much longer.

notes.title: THIS WEEK ON KAIROS
notes.content:
[p]Hey Vault Hunters! Welcome to “This Week on Kairos” - a weekly post where we share everything happening across the world of [i]Borderlands 4[/i], from developer updates to community highlights and beyond.[/p][p]Every Friday, we’ll be here with the latest news, fan creations, dev spotlights, helpful resources, and anything else we think you’ll want to see. Whether you're looking to catch up, dive deeper, or just see what your fellow players are up to, this is the place.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/8fb96d3607a8c746d71170c41f4f49a7cb5b5dbd.png"][/img][/p][h3]Seven More Days! Are You Ready?[/h3][p]Are you all ready to take down the Timekeeper? Well, too bad if you’re not, because we have SEVEN MORE DAYS until launch! The dev team has worked SO hard on this passion project, and we cannot WAIT to press the big red button next Thursday, September 11![/p][p][/p][p]Our Gameplay Launch Trailer is here to kick off the final countdown:[/p][previewyoutube="DJ17oRR4Ny4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]For many Vault Hunters, finishing the campaign is just the start of the adventure—and with [i]Borderlands 4[/i]'s endgame built around deep-yet-accessible systems, players of all skill levels will have more reasons to keep wreaking havoc on Kairos after the main story is complete. In the simplest terms, the goal of [i]Borderlands 4[/i]'s endgame is to make the most badass Vault Hunter possible through a combination of the best loot and the most efficient skill builds. Learn more here:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="VV9FRQYVbhk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Wherever you are in the world, the launch times are listed here below:
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/7391560fd4a13607e6560d5b019f9b476a414247.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/4b67de79a041ff6e22b99f1e28acb97d774dc818.png"][/img][/p][h3]Vault Hunters, Assemble![/h3][p]We were SO excited to announce the Voice Cast for our Vault Hunters this week! Working with them and bringing these characters to life has been an unforgettable experience to so many of us. This isn’t the last you’ve heard of them, though! We’ll have more VA content to share over the weeks ahead.[/p][previewyoutube="mnaz47_MBfY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/1ac8af64c921b9f8d4366cd8d0041e552a892963.png"][/img][/p][h3]In Case You Missed It: PAX West Roundup[/h3][p]We had SUCH a blast (literally) at PAX West this past weekend. Our rage room was heard throughout the entire convention hall, and brought in so many participants (including an entire gaggle of drag queens and the Washington Secretary of State)!  We also had thousands of folks get hands-on gameplay in our front-and-center booth, and pose for photos with our incredibly talented cosplayers. Here are just a few of our favorite highlights:[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/64d3378bc6c010a9380d3970b34394bebf8a6158.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/b74e6f972c56507b56a2cae620f7ebf62e4e4bb8.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/f25e0258338f80a0c914148b42627dfcd8a01610.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/f6a57c101bd492476d7560dd099efb1d5fca6336.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/a41a5e932417f95442db2254682905e1dfb01cb7.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]Not only that, but on Friday we held the Gearbox Main Theater Show, focusing on [i]Borderlands 4[/i]'s endgame systems and post-launch content! Vault Hunters from all over the country came to hear about our free updates, DLC news, and the new challenges to expect once they've completed the main campaign.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/016efd98d01aa01dd5f45d37aa116ddd3d51480b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Speaking of Roadmap…[/h3][p]If you missed the roadmap on our PAX West panel, don’t worry - you can take a look at what’s going to happen for the next few months on our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/1285190/announcements/detail/543367091067028285?snr=2___"][u]Post-Launch Roadmap Steam post[/u][/url]. We have a lot of cool stuff coming out in the weeks and months to come, both paid and free, and can’t wait to show you more further down the line!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/ab25e44b39d62a64ac5b0b0a357fc0f989288e5e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Have You Quit Earth Today?[/h3][p]In case you haven’t seen it, our live-action Quit Earth Live Action Trailer for [i]Borderlands 4[/i] released last week. There were Rippers riding couches, apartment demolitions, a gun-wielding bunny, a driving dog, and… an elephant?! A lot of people came together to pull off these stunts and practical effects as an homage to the chaos that happens in the [i]Borderlands[/i] universe every day. Check out these behind-the-scenes shots from the [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dKjgWa7cpCI"][u]Quit Earth[/u][/url] project:[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/811bb6be63c6cf46031609c32065760e379f3c10.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/230a75482280dfc626cd7ace01e9ec87dcef135e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/c3357e31f02a7b46f85294191252fe90a9c5337c.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/e1a82a89c9eeae8d4091f1ddb1c1dbf778808e81.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/f72c8de5831f110f20bd4f2bca5015e923864647.png"][/img][/p][h3]Behind the Team: Joel McDonald, [i]Borderlands 4[/i] Voiceover Producer[/h3][p]Every week, we’re spotlighting one of the minds behind the mayhem. You’ll get to learn about folks from both Gearbox and 2K, and how each person who touches the game both influences and is influenced by [i]Borderlands 4[/i]. This week, we're talking with [b]Joel McDonald[/b], Gearbox’s Voiceover Producer[b]:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]How do you work with writers, directors, and actors to bring characters to life?[/b][/p][p]Every game dev is a storyteller in their own way. By the time a new character gets to the VO Direction department, artists, and designers, and writers, and others have all put their fingerprints on who these characters are and what their story is. It’s our job to honor our coworkers by casting the exact right actor to do justice to the wonderful new character they’ve created. That means we need to start with a deep understanding of what got the character to that point in the process, as well as everyone’s needs, wants, and expectations. [/p][p]Once we’ve had those conversations, have a solid foundation, and found the perfect actor to fill the role, the next step is helping to further elevate the material – art, dialog, etc. – through performance. Everyone else in the process has had time to play, experiment, and maybe even trip and backtrack a time or two. We make sure our actors have those same opportunities. In the booth, we try to gently guide our actors as they “find” the character we’ve tasked them with bringing to life, all while staying faithful to the folks who brought it to us.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s the most rewarding part of seeing a character concept go from script to fully voiced character?[/b][/p][p]For me, it’s seeing those moments that already worked beautifully on the page get brought to life. It’s getting the laughs in the right spots, catching the audience off guard and making them think or tear up… and earning the silence when we can. But mostly, I think it’s that moment when I realize the actor barely needs me anymore. When they understand their role, when they’ve internalized who they are and what motivates them, I get to fade into the background and enjoy the fireworks. I like fireworks.[/p][p][/p][p][b]If your life had a narrator, whose voice would you want it to be and why?[/b][/p][p]Gabe Kunda. If you know, you know.[/p][p][/p][h3]Community Creative Corner[/h3][p]Our community members aren’t just gamers—many of you are also artists. Whether it’s cosplay, digital art, or some yet-to-be-invented medium, we’re your biggest fans. Check out this week’s hand-picked fan creations:[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/659920ca03848859587372d144d98c0b8067c190.png"][/img][url="https://www.instagram.com/moth_bitez/"][u][i]moth_bitez[/i][/u][/url][/h3][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/c72a392a6a682945adbad2ba03b6d17358a53f06.png"][/img][/h3][h3][url="https://www.tumblr.com/rottenzone"][u][i]rottenzone[/i][/u][/url][/h3][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/68bb7e2d2444acd08699d00c66e81cd05ea004b8.png"][/img][url="https://www.tumblr.com/1ncend1ary"][u][i]1ncend1ary[/i][/u][/url][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/03fac58a5b167c6b4b9e2acddebab532de13f6c6.png"][/img][/p][p]That’s it for this week—more updates, more chaos, and maybe a few surprises coming next Friday. Until then: keep your ECHOnet tuned and your loot luck high.[/p][p]Happy Hunting,
[b]The Borderlands Team[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/cab2860dd2091c9cc501e726e1b96f9a4579849a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1285190/Borderlands_4/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]
