notes.title: Borderlands 4 endgame details: Ultimate Vault Hunter Mode and more
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="VV9FRQYVbhk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]For many Vault Hunters, finishing the campaign is just the start of the adventure—and with [i]Borderlands 4[/i]'s endgame built around deep-yet-accessible systems, players of all skill levels will have more reasons to keep wreaking havoc on Kairos after the main story is complete. In the simplest terms, the goal of [i]Borderlands 4[/i]'s endgame is to make the most badass Vault Hunter possible through a combination of the best loot and the most efficient skill builds.[/p][p][/p][p]Making sure [i]Borderlands 4[/i]'s endgame stays engaging long after you've rolled credits is a huge focus for the team, creating a highly replayable loot chase whether you're continually powering your main character up with new gear or rolling alts to try out other Vault Hunter classes. Today, we're excited to give you an overview of the [i]Borderlands 4[/i]'s endgame systems that'll keep you coming back for more looter shooter action.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/dba5d943ec09ef276c16264c19ea5d9e979afdaf.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Ultimate Vault Hunter Mode: Take on tougher, more varied challenges for better loot[/h2][p][i]Borderlands [/i]is all about the loot chase, with endgame revolving around the loop of challenging yourself against tough enemies, amassing the awesome loot they drop, then using it to strengthen your build and take on even more difficult challenges for even better loot. If [i]Borderlands 4[/i]'s endgame loop is like making an ascent toward building the most badass Vault Hunter imaginable, think of Ultimate Vault Hunter Mode as the mountain you'll enjoy climbing to get there.[/p][p][/p][p]To access Ultimate Vault Hunter Mode, simply finish the campaign with your first character. As the name implies, enemies will be much, much tougher and deadlier in Ultimate Vault Hunter Mode—but the loot they drop will be appropriately powerful as a reward for your efforts.[/p][p][/p][p]Playing in Ultimate Vault Hunter Mode intensifies the risk and reward of [i]Borderlands 4[/i]'s looter shooter firefights. You should expect more demanding, chaotic battles against enemies that globally scale to your level; you'll have to deal with increased damage scaling, while your opponents get intimidating modifiers like higher damage, bigger health pools, or resistance to certain elemental effects. But should you triumph, you'll rake in big rewards: better loot that can supercharge your build, plus appropriately scaled-up XP and increased in-game currency in the form of Cash and Eridium. [/p][p][/p][p]When [i]Borderlands 4[/i] launches, Ultimate Vault Hunter Mode will have five difficulty levels, which are unlocked incrementally by completing challenges spread across Kairos and will put your skills and Vault Hunters' builds to the test. Once you've completed enough challenges, you'll face a climactic trial: a Wildcard Mission, which tasks you with replaying a mission filled with buffed enemies who have a new set of lethal traits.[/p][p][/p][p]Successfully surviving the absolute chaos of a Wildcard Mission will unlock the next difficult Ultimate Vault Hunter level, creating a satisfying cycle of increasing your power and taking on tough-but-fair adversaries. Ultimate Vault Hunter Mode is also designed to be welcoming to players of all kinds, as you can escalate the increasing difficulty levels at your own pace and take on new challenges whenever you feel ready.[/p][p][/p][h2]Dedicated drops and other optimizations for loot farming[/h2][p]They say that nothing worth having comes easy, so getting the very best loot possible in [i]Borderlands 4[/i] is going to require loot farming, something every hardcore player knows and loves. In [i]Borderlands 4[/i], the act of loot farming has been improved to offer more variety and more predictable goals—including dedicated drops, another inclusion inspired by player feedback. Instead of fighting the same bosses over and over again in the same part of the map, you're now incentivized to take the fight across Kairos and fight a wide variety of enemies in the pursuit of the specific loot you're looking for.[/p][p][/p][p]In addition to their loot drops, hunting bosses across Kairos pays well thanks to Contracts, with completion rewards that include a valuable in-game currency earned through gameplay: Eridium. These iconic chunks of purple crystal have made their way to Kairos courtesy of the Elpis cataclysm, and you'll spend Eridium on endgame activities like respeccing your Specialization tree (more on that in a bit) and spinning up Moxxi's Big Encore Machine. [/p][p][/p][p]Back in the [i][u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/news/gameplay-showcase/"]Borderlands 4[/url][/u][/i][u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/news/gameplay-showcase/"] Gameplay Showcase[/url][/u], we revealed Moxxi's Big Encore Machine as a way to repeatedly fight bosses you've beaten without needing to exit and re-enter the game—a huge timesaver for farming desirable boss loot. In [i]Borderlands 4[/i], you can spend some Eridium to activate Moxxi's Big Encore Machine and fight the desired boss right then and there, without the need for save-loading shenanigans or rebooting the game entirely. It's an especially great quality-of-life improvement for endgame loot farming, so big thanks to Moxxi for making it happen.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/03c6c45aa5a8f002e56ea49f5218c9258af28066.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Weekly reasons to take on new challenges[/h2][p]After launch, [i]Borderlands 4[/i] will be getting plenty of Paid Content via post-launch DLC and Free Content available to all players, which you can learn about in this [i][u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/news/post-launch-roadmap/"]Borderlands 4 [/url][/u][/i][u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/news/post-launch-roadmap/"]Post-Launch Roadmap article[/url][/u]. But in between the bigger content drops, [i]Borderlands 4[/i] also offers weekly incentives to come back to Kairos for fresh challenges and rewards.[/p][p][/p][p]If you're looking to pick a new fight each week, you should test your might against the Weekly Big Encore Boss. Everyone will get the chance to take on the same Big Encore Boss each week, which is a tougher variant with an even more rewarding loot pool. You can face off against this souped-up boss using Moxxi's Big Encore Machine. [/p][p][/p][p]In that same vein of embracing new challenges, all players will get the same Weekly Wildcard Mission marked on their map, ensuring that everyone takes on the same set of additional enemy traits so the community can collectively figure out the optimal ways to overcome this challenge. Best of all, Weekly Wildcard Missions will have a guaranteed Legendary drop that you can repeatedly earn to get your ideal roll.[/p][p][/p][p]Lastly, we're delighted to confirm that Maurice, everyone's favorite human-studying Saurian, has managed to set up shop on Kairos in [i]Borderlands 4.[/i] Each week, Maurice's Black Market Machine will spawn in a new location somewhere on Kairos; if you manage to find it, you'll be able to purchase highly coveted Legendary loot for in-game cash. Although its location will be the same for all players each week, the inventory on offer in Maurice's Black Market Machine is unique to each player. It's worth regularly coordinating with friends and joining their game if their version of Maurice's Black Market Machine has the perfect Legendary you've been looking for, and vice versa![/p][p][/p][h2]Firmware: Set bonuses that synergize with your build[/h2][p][i]Borderlands 4[/i]'s Firmware system brings gear sets to the [i]Borderlands [/i]series for the first time ever. This is a hugely important addition to the loot economy of [i]Borderlands 4[/i], and will spark even more decision-making as you plan your perfect build using the right mix of Firmware.[/p][p][/p][p]Firmware set bonuses have a wide range of effects, but they all have three tiers: Minor (1 piece of Firmware equipped), Major (2 pieces of the same Firmware), and Full (3 pieces). Minor and Major bonuses provided by Firmware are typically flat increases to stats like Ordnance damage or Action Skill Cooldown rate, but Full bonuses can provide unique effects like dropping down missile strikes or boosting your damage and lifesteal when your health gets low.[/p][p][/p][p]Crucially, Firmware does [i]not [/i]apply to the four primary weapons in your loadout, as it only has a chance to spawn on Repkits, Ordnance, Class Mods, Shields, and Enhancements. That means you can only have five total pieces of Firmware-enabled gear equipped at a time. [/p][p][/p][p]You'll need to make tough decisions when shaping your build: do you go all-in to get a Full and Major bonus with three and two Firmware set gear pieces respectively, or do you spread out for a wider variety of Minor and Major bonuses? The choice is yours—but whatever you decide, Firmware bonuses go a long way towards making a more effective Vault Hunter build. [/p][p][/p][p]Once you've completed the main campaign, you can transfer Firmware from one piece of gear to another using a Transfer Machine. It's important to note that the gear that has Firmware transferred away from it will be destroyed, and existing Firmware on the target piece of gear will be replaced. Depending on the gear you're sacrificing, transferring Firmware can be a serious investment, but absolutely worth it to help achieve your perfect build.[/p][p][/p][p]Firmware isn't exclusive to [i]Borderlands 4[/i]'s endgame, as you'll start encountering loot drops with Firmware as early as level 25. By the time you've reached the endgame, you'll be well acclimated to the ways Firmware can strengthen your build—and you'll be ready to chase after new Firmware sets that will only drop in Ultimate Vault Hunter Mode.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/f65e78fbe5dedd4a1478992bad2ec96e6dc2fa57.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Specializations: Universal upgrades for all of your Vault Hunters[/h2][p][i]Borderlands 4[/i]'s[i] [/i]Specializations system is a streamlined way to steadily and continuously increase the power of your characters account-wide just by playing. Once you've completed the main campaign, you'll unlock the Specializations XP bar that can level up hundreds of times, providing incremental buffs that eventually open up meaningful choices for how to strengthen your favorite builds. Think of Specializations as an endgame progression system in the same vein as [i]Borderlands 2[/i]'s Badass Ranks and [i]Borderlands 3[/i]'s Guardian Ranks.[/p][p][/p][p]There are four basic nodes to level up on the Specialization tree, which provide straightforward buffs to stats like Maximum Health & Shields or Gun Damage. Once you've leveled up a basic node far enough, you'll unlock passive Specialization Skills to slot into socket spaces. Initially, you'll only have access to one socket for slotting in Specializations; after you've leveled up enough, you can have up to a maximum of four sockets.[/p][p][/p][p]Long-term, your goal is to reach some or all of the three Prestige nodes, which can only be accessed once you've leveled up enough and invested the requisite points in the basic nodes. As an example, the Gadgeteer Prestige node that buffs your Ordnance will only be unlocked after you've invested at least 10 Specialization Points into both the Survivor and Brute basic nodes. Slotting your Specialization sockets will provide noticeable spikes to your power level over time, though you're always free to leave sockets empty or respec Specialization points entirely if you're looking for more of a challenge on a new character after countless hours of leveling up.[/p][p][/p][h2]Invincible Bosses: The true test of your Vault Hunter build[/h2][p]A few months after launch, after you've had time to sharpen your skills and craft your best builds, you [i]might[/i] be ready to take on a new kind of deadly challenge that will be free additions for all players: Invincible Bosses, who await challengers in new arenas on Kairos. Think of them as bosses on steroids: massive health pools (not literally invincible, but close to it), extremely lethal attack damage, and new modifiers that can make quick work of any unprepared Vault Hunters. [/p][p][/p][p]If you have what it takes to defeat them, Invincible Bosses drop some of the absolute best loot in the game. The first Invincible Boss is planned to be implemented in Q4 2025, so do what you can to prepare yourself before then.[/p][p][/p][h2]Pearlescent rarity: A new loot tier above Legendary[/h2][p]You asked, we listened: Pearlescents are coming back for [i]Borderlands 4[/i], with plans to add them as a free update to all players alongside Bounty Pack 2 in Q1 2026. Pearlescent gear drops will be incredibly difficult to find, but their power level will match their coveted rarity.[/p][p][/p][h2]Upcoming Paid and Free content and more[/h2][p]Now that you've read a comprehensive rundown of [i]Borderlands 4[/i]'s endgame systems, make sure to read up on the [i][u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/news/post-launch-roadmap/"]Borderlands 4 [/url][/u][/i][u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/news/post-launch-roadmap/"]Post-Launch Roadmap[/url][/u] to find out more about the content coming after launch, including Paid Content like Bounty Packs and Story Packs, and Free Updates like additional levels for Ultimate Vault Hunter Mode and the aforementioned Pearlescent rarity![/p][p][/p][p]If you've yet to pre-purchase your copy of [i]Borderlands 4[/i], there's still time before we crash-land into Kairos starting on September 12, 2025. While we await launch, you can also check out the Vault Hunter pages for [u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/vex/"]Vex[/url][/u], [u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/rafa/"]Rafa[/url][/u], [u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/amon/"]Amon[/url][/u], and [u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/harlowe/"]Harlowe[/url][/u] to plan out builds around their Action Skills and skill trees as you work your way up through the massive amount of endgame content![/p][p][/p][p]For an in-depth breakdown of this info, check out the additional insights shared by Gearbox devs from our livestreamed PAX West panel:[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="uN52Bca_LDM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1285190/Borderlands_4/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Borderlands 4 delivers deep, tricky FPS combat, but it still hasn't hooked me
notes.content:
Gearbox's deep dives into Borderlands 4's seemingly endless combat systems have left me pretty stunned. Cherry-picking and evolving some of the best bits of the previous games, and adding in some new layers too, the amount being promised is mind-blowing. But when everything comes together, how do they feel? At Gamescom, I was able to get around 25 minutes of hands-on time with Borderlands 4, trying out one of its new Primordial Vaults, and while there were certainly some impressive aspects, it didn't sink its hooks into me quite like I hoped it would.

notes.title: Borderlands 4 Post-Launch Roadmap
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/ab25e44b39d62a64ac5b0b0a357fc0f989288e5e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The launch of [i]Borderlands 4 [/i]is just mere weeks away on September 12, 2025. But the team at Gearbox is already hard at work on a Vault-load of post-launch content—including lots of new story content and two new Vault Hunters—and in-game events that will keep your adventures on Kairos going strong![/p][p][/p][p]For now, as we prepare to wreak havoc against the tyrannical Timekeeper as one of four badass new Vault Hunters, we hope the roadmap above offers an exciting sense of what's incoming after launch. Below, we'll break down the types of post-launch content you can expect, including Paid Content via DLC packs and Free Content available for all players.[/p][p][/p][h2]Paid Content[/h2][h3]Story Packs* with new Vault Hunters and new Story Scenarios[/h3][p]Further out from launch, we'll see extended, post-launch narrative content [i]Borderlands [/i]fans know and love, with two Story Packs coming in 2026 and the first arriving in Q1! Each Story Pack will include multiple main missions and side missions set in a new zone of Kairos, a brand-new Vault Hunter, new gear to earn, and a bunch of new cosmetics, namely:[/p][list][*][p]2 Vault Hunter Heads usable by all Vault Hunters[/p][/*][*][p]2 Vault Hunter Heads for the new Vault Hunter[/p][/*][*][p]4 Vault Hunter Skins usable by all Vault Hunters[/p][/*][*][p]4 Weapon Skins[/p][/*][*][p]2 Vehicle Paintjobs[/p][/*][*][p]3 ECHO-4 Drone Skin & Attachments[/p][/*][*][p]1 ECHO-4 Frame[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]The first Story Pack will be a bloody, cosmic-horror-inspired tale entitled [b]Mad Ellie and the Vault of the Damned. [/b]As you might've guessed, it stars the one-and-only Ellie, Pandoran mechanic extraordinaire and daughter of Moxxi. That's all we can say about the narrative specifics at the moment (tune in to our PAX West panel for more), but you can look forward to seeing new [i]and [/i]returning characters in each Story Pack. In other words, expect to see a familiar face or two in the second Story Pack, too. For now, you'll have to stay tuned for more details.[/p][p]
[/p][p]If you've played any of the full-fledged DLC adventures from [i]Borderlands 3[/i], you can expect a similar level of intense looter shooter action, gripping stories, and killer new loot to collect in the [i]Borderlands 4[/i]'s Story Pack DLCs. We know that additional Vault Hunters are always a big request from the community, so we can't wait for you to meet [i]Borderlands 4[/i]'s DLC Vault Hunters. It also can't be understated how impactful each DLC Vault Hunter will be, each offering all-new possibilities and build playstyles with their three unique Action Skills and branching skill trees just like the base game Vault Hunters. [/p][p]
[/p][p]You can learn more about the Vault Hunter included in our first Story Pack by tuning in during Tokyo Game Show 2025 toward the end of September. Both Story Packs are included in [i]Borderlands 4 Super Deluxe Edition[/i], and will also be available for individual purchase.[/p][p][/p][h3]Bounty Packs** with new Missions, Legendary Gear and loot-filled Vault Cards[/h3][p]Bounty Packs will include new bite-sized-yet-flavorful narrative content, along with new gear to earn and cosmetics to collect—plus a Vault Card that lets you unlock additional loot through gameplay. Four Bounty Packs are included in the Bounty Pack Bundle that comes with the [i]Deluxe Edition [/i]and [i]Super Deluxe Edition [/i]of [i]Borderlands 4[/i]. [/p][p]
[/p][p]Each Bounty Pack features new Main Missions, revealing more about the various NPCs of Kairos, as well as a new Boss to take down; our first Bounty Pack focuses on Rush, the affable leader of the Outbounders faction stationed in the Fadefields. You can also expect loot in the form of a new Legendary Gear drop, a Vault Hunter Skin usable by all Vault Hunters, an ECHO-4 Drone Skin, and a new Digirunner Vehicle. You'll also get a Vault Card, with its unique set of 24 cosmetic items and four pieces of re-rollable gear (separate from the Legendary Gear included in the Bounty Pack) that you'll earn through gameplay. All non-cosmetic Vault Card gear can be earned repeatedly until you roll one with stats that perfectly suit your build.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Playing [i]Borderlands 4[/i] with a Vault Card active gives you more loot and XP via Daily and Weekly challenges, which can unlock additional rewards. Each Vault Card is built around a distinct theme, and can be leveled up at your own pace (no time limits or expiring rewards here). Once activated, Vault Card progression works just like leveling up: it's all driven by how much XP you're gaining. By exploring Kairos, killing enemies, and completing quests, you'll fill up your Vault Card progression bar in addition to your regular XP bar![/p][p]
[/p][p]There will also be a rotation of Daily and Weekly Challenges from a large pool of possibilities, giving you opportunities to level up your Vault Cards even faster. Even after you've unlocked all of a Vault Card's unique loot, you can keep leveling it up to earn new rolls of the same gear until you get the drop that perfectly suits your build. [/p][p]
[/p][p]Each Vault Card can only be acquired as part of an individual Bounty Pack. Four Vault Cards total are included with [i]Borderlands 4 Deluxe Edition [/i]and[i] Super Deluxe Edition[/i] as part of the Bounty Pack Bundle. Bounty Packs will also be available for individual purchase.[/p][p][/p][h2]Free Content[/h2][p]In addition to the Paid Content of DLC, we're thrilled to be bringing plenty of free content to all players following the launch of [i]Borderlands 4[/i]. Along with steady updates that will keep all Vault Hunter builds feeling appropriately powerful, you can expect these free additions:[/p][p][/p][h3]Invincible Bosses[/h3][p]A few months after launch, after you've had time to sharpen your skills and craft your best builds, you might be ready to take on Invincible Bosses, who await challengers in new arenas on Kairos. Think of them as bosses on steroids: new unique mechanics, massive health pools (not literally invincible, but close to it), extremely lethal attack damage, and other new modifiers that can make quick work of any unprepared Vault Hunters. If you have what it takes to defeat them, Invincible Bosses drop some of the absolute best loot in the game. The first Invincible Boss is planned to be added as a free update in Q4 2025***, so do what you can to prepare yourself before then.[/p][p][/p][h3]Weekly Challenges[/h3][p][i]Borderlands 4[/i] includes multiple types of free weekly content to keep things fresh:[/p][list][*][p][b]Weekly Big Encore Boss[/b]: Each week, players can take on the same boss at Moxxi's Big Encore Machine by spending the in-game Eridium currency earned through gameplay. This Big Encore Boss is a tougher variant with an even more rewarding loot pool should you manage to take them down.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weekly Wildcard Missions[/b]: All players will get the same Weekly Wildcard Mission added to their map, ensuring that everyone takes on the same set of additional enemy traits so the community can collectively figure out the optimal ways to overcome this challenge. Best of all, Weekly Wildcard Missions will have a guaranteed Legendary drop that you can repeatedly earn to get your ideal roll.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Maurice's Black Market Machine[/b]: Everyone's favorite Saurian is offering his wares in [i]Borderlands 4[/i] via Maurice's Black Market Machine, which spawns in a new location somewhere on Kairos each week and offers highly coveted Legendary loot for in-game cash if you can manage to find it. Although its location will be the same for all players each week, the inventory on offer in Maurice's Black Market Machine is unique to each player. It's worth regularly coordinating with friends and joining their game if their version of Maurice's Black Market Machine has the perfect Legendary you've been looking for, and vice versa![/p][/*][/list][h3]Pearlescent rarity: A new loot tier above Legendary[/h3][p]You asked, we listened: Pearlescents are coming back for [i]Borderlands 4[/i], with plans to add them as a free update to all players alongside Bounty Pack 2 in Q1 2026.*** Pearlescent gear drops will be incredibly difficult to find, but their power level will match their coveted rarity.[/p][p][/p][h3]Seasonal Mini-Events[/h3][p]Just in time for spooky season, Horrors of Kairos is coming to [i]Borderlands 4[/i] this October as the first in our new slate of Seasonal Mini-Events. With each event, you can look forward to gameplay tweaks—like a new type of weather, in this case—along with new cosmetic items and new Legendary gear added to the world boss spawn pool. These Seasonal Mini-Events will only be available for a limited time, so make sure you don't miss them! We'll have more details to share on Horrors of Kairos soon after launch.[/p][p][/p][h3]Endgame with Ultimate Vault Hunter Mode and more[/h3][p]As part of [i][u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/news/endgame-overview/"]Borderlands 4[/url][/u][/i][u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/news/endgame-overview/"]'s robust suite of endgame content[/url][/u], we'll be rolling out free updates to Ultimate Vault Hunter Mode, adding additional levels of difficulty that you'll have to unlock via gameplay. If you can overcome the challenges of Ultimate Vault Hunter Mode, you'll be rewarded with the best loot rolls in the game, steadily taking your Vault Hunter's power level to unseen heights. [/p][p]You can learn more about all these endgame activities in our [i][u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/news/endgame-overview/"]Borderlands 4[/url][/u][/i][u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/news/endgame-overview/"] endgame preview[/url][/u] article. [/p][p][/p][p]If you've yet to pre-purchase your copy of the game, there's still time before we crash-land into Kairos starting on September 12, 2025. While we await launch, you can also check out the Vault Hunter pages for [u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/vex/"]Vex[/url][/u], [u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/rafa/"]Rafa[/url][/u], [u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/amon/"]Amon[/url][/u], and [u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/harlowe/"]Harlowe[/url][/u] to plan out how you'll shape their Action Skills and skill trees into your ideal, personalized builds.[/p][p][/p][p]For an in-depth breakdown of this info, check out the additional insights shared by Gearbox devs from our [u][url="https://www.twitch.tv/gearboxofficial/videos?filter=archives&sort=time"]livestreamed PAX West panel[/url][/u].[/p][p]
[/p][p][i]*Story Packs are paid post-launch DLC that are included with the Borderlands 4 Vault Hunter Pack, and included in Borderlands 4 Super Deluxe Edition. They will also be available for separate purchase (base game required). Exact release timings of each Story Pack to be announced at a later date and will be subject to change. Terms apply.[/i][/p][p][i]**Bounty Packs are paid post-launch DLC that are included with the Borderlands 4 Bounty Pack Bundle, and included with the Deluxe and Super Deluxe Editions of Borderlands 4. They will also be available for separate purchase (base game required). Exact release timings of each Bounty Pack to be announced at a later date and will be subject to change. Terms apply. [/i][/p][p][i]***Exact release timing to be announced at a later date and will be subject to change.[/i][/p][p]

notes.title: THIS WEEK ON KAIROS
notes.content:
[p]Hey Vault Hunters! Welcome to “This Week on Kairos” - a weekly post where we share everything happening across the world of [i]Borderlands 4[/i], from developer updates to community highlights and beyond.[/p][p]Every Friday, we’ll be here with the latest news, fan creations, dev spotlights, helpful resources, and anything else we think you’ll want to see. Whether you're looking to catch up, dive deeper, or just see what your fellow players are up to, this is the place.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfVszB-OoG41v1soaurTTAX1E5zOP80xYpGk0KELuGQcJIYS67gm4l9lbPyUtIliPaDD6s7aLD_fvo5OusAGS4bEju2eWhC9Lahb1CFj22cXpstzZnyzoo-yA0TRBtA-H3yrN8V?key=CmWrcAO1hsRfwUsQtzMvrA"][/img][/p][h2]In Case You Missed It: From Gamescom to PAX West[/h2][p]We’ve been on the road (and in the air), traveling the world to connect with YOU. Gamescom was such a blast (literally), with hands-on gameplay, the infamous Rage Room, and talented cosplayers taking on some of our favorite characters. And while we were so sad to leave, we’re so excited to be hitting PAX West RIGHT NOW. Our Gearbox Main Theater Showcase panel was earlier today, and we will be on the floor all weekend with gameplay and… you guessed it, our RAGE ROOM.[/p][p]We’ll share more about this weekend’s events in the next issue, but for now, here are some moments from Gamescom that are too good to not share:[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfwSJiGVwH4RLBGAIvrHaBjohgorb35yr1M68hHwRlOgGTcgZt3yUtCrhpft8afnBezWAxtIFZnSdTMF7m5JTJkqi3ivMnrEXBLc3KSCdwVOrptMI_9i-_KWuchy38CiGsi_Jjzdg?key=CmWrcAO1hsRfwUsQtzMvrA"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcGsoXS0vihuZk8oDLyPXlCUvRNprDoYs76UOzdAR5HBb1FrxI_b-69Vw_PnZhoKmQa7lF_Bv7Y0bHX1wjmG7GHaRLV5852AUrqTpIeHzTz2c_oKSFAWt6NSd4OduXK5nr8wnCA?key=CmWrcAO1hsRfwUsQtzMvrA"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXc097inb8ozCa_DP19TF7U5s4qMDpNGtknwmff9IJSBDBsnPuehjqbk5vAlBixD_g11RXZqFvE94o2ffKyXrMfyH2dECIdz5An5x55WfuK7XIGCjoj2O_EH_YOJcU1gIkcQUvgLEw?key=CmWrcAO1hsRfwUsQtzMvrA"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcI7YPIMXdhTpFhXL8ATeINqjAqA7vznzN7fD8pwPZccVMFXijBnNQKIkQYOgS6rcsNuqZQonKRk9yr8ugXaGF072DLhT-jAyu5hPLKtijPh4Zvk7cLcwrqfbBJ_6CpD9plcCVn6g?key=CmWrcAO1hsRfwUsQtzMvrA"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h2]Vault Hunters Reporting for Duty[/h2][p]If you’ve been online the past few weeks, you’ve probably caught the Vault Hunter Character Shorts. But just in case you missed them, or want to rewatch them again, we got you:[/p][p][/p][p]"Purple Friday" feature’s Vex's retelling of the events that set her down the path to becoming a Vault Hunter:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BzgZvUMgtSs"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]"YOLT" features Rafa’s retelling of how he ended up going AWOL after cutting ties with the Tediore corporation:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=REP1cuGbP-8"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]"Demons" features Amon's retelling of a run-in with a Vault-obsessed cult much like the one he survived: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s_36fMCjNcI"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]"Family Reunion" features Harlowe's retelling of a thrilling Digirunner chase that resulted in an unexpected reunion with a relative:  [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YqtvuH4uV2E"][/dynamiclink]
[/p][h2]Quality of Life News: Sort and Filter[/h2][p]Looting got a hell of a lot easier with the following Sort and Filter features. In [i]Borderlands 4[/i], players will be able to sort their equipment by:[/p][list][*][p]Recent (the order in which items were picked up) [/p][/*][*][p]Rarity[/p][/*][*][p]Type[/p][/*][*][p]Level Requirement[/p][/*][*][p]Sell Value [/p][/*][*][p]Manufacturer[/p][/*][*][p]"Comparable" stats on item cards, like Damage, Accuracy, etc.[/p][/*][/list][p]The stat sorts that are available for players to choose from is a dynamically populated list, meaning there will be more options as you pick up more items, and fewer options when you sell or drop items.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeGHdvgnFTwvBgUEz1Jar9YRyLnw6_4lLhRE1Opwkke_EiABUasCePDVXIgDA4-lVuSnPqEuQgRCYDING5recv4Ey3LZc2xGXFWTmMN0ONqk57arVdHDUKZxSGL6NXUes209grJ?key=CmWrcAO1hsRfwUsQtzMvrA"][/img][/p][p]Comparing an item while sorting by stat will also show comparison indicators for each item being sorted.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeLlkN9r01oqnCJ-SLH05weqpdUTBfBRrxb6vYHkqPmWjFht_Z2VnDi4rTAmltOnabzweoCAONleBN7tpOe1AxTQjXg3gnL5Yp41FfGowi5vsAt_52U-vi9-tRkOFyIZwig3ACd?key=CmWrcAO1hsRfwUsQtzMvrA"][/img][/p][h3]Filters[/h3][p]Filters have been a longtime request from players and are being implemented for BL4. Like the stat sorting, the filter list is populated dynamically based on the player's current inventory. Items that match the current filter get pushed to the front of the list and items which do not match also get slightly dimmer.[/p][p]This allows players to quickly narrow down item searches by very specific criteria, creating a quick "cross-section" view of matching items.[/p][p]Criteria including:[/p][list][*][p]Rarity[/p][/*][*][p]Damage Type [/p][list][*][p]Elemental damage types as well as Kinetic (non-elemental)[/p][/*][*][p]Damage type might be for primary or secondary or both firing modes on a weapon[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Item Type (and Subtype) [/p][list][*][p]e.g. Pistol, SMG, Assault Rifle, Energy Shield, Armor Shield, Grenade, etc...[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Has Firmware[/p][/*][*][p]Equipped/Unequipped[/p][/*][*][p]Manufacturer[/p][/*][*][p]Item Marker [/p][list][*][p]Favorite, Trash, Tag Group, etc...[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfIOotbgRSw--q61tzKtke8r8mInGyy4GPmO8ZF4iHHEfLclw2PpPHt_wEvMnYYh1JIiS_QFgbZwXl2eccfFl8vNklPjxJbNKXDQTUW1dV59UqffpM-CvXCx1RQpixH3BTAWIc01g?key=CmWrcAO1hsRfwUsQtzMvrA"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf7_phJOkzbG6zf0W-Hyc0Uz9GwtmqrEbnNaLyA_1JlZ0OS0imDH-v7cnTRmGxdp1zWlg2Y0DII_21ikVpLKWhRPaLykZKcCJfJUGkKxOFPbtrahMco8AkgBkKY8kIXg0XAAdT-?key=CmWrcAO1hsRfwUsQtzMvrA"][/img][/p][p]Item counts in the filter are relative to the current filter settings. These two screenshots are from the same set of items. When filtering by Incendiary and/or Shock damage types, there are no Pistols which match those criteria, so the Pistols entry shows "0" and is unselectable. However, this inventory does have Pistols – When filtering by Pistol, we can quickly see there are 3 and we expect none of them to be Incendiary or Shock type, so those now show "0" and are unselectable. [/p][p]Within the Type group, the other options all now show a number wrapped in parenthesis "(#)", indicating that is how many items almost match the current filter. For example, no Shotguns match the current filter because we're currently only filtering by Pistols. If we add Shotguns to the filter we will see 5 items added to the matching items list.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdVhYTZ7IXEPG_AbwNdzDRpfgC4CWQJahIkzwDLET8O6EfwLJ3nDstZldWvK5cJoOVBtiZboU6Wy49A98bGr36oZuGzZ5suBpMlg1NhBpW2LkYMN18i6jQFwYtFYMVBcLWUrvmOzg?key=CmWrcAO1hsRfwUsQtzMvrA"][/img][/p][p]At least one of those Shotguns must have elemental damage associated with it, since Kinetic was the only option available before. Let's see which one.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcZuIkTJZzp3OkechJHLwg02kVV3lcRLg0fyoPFw4-0x9tzBN0QrRaLogtzWdrCRpYO75dm_hS5nkHManW-UMZNLDXOL9T8trbCiPJ2jFHtX_ywb747ymnnSl7ZGqdW4Mhwg6Mm7A?key=CmWrcAO1hsRfwUsQtzMvrA"][/img][/p][p]Now we have only one item that matches [b]all [/b]of the criteria. We can tell from the Filter list alone that it's a Common rarity Shotgun that also can deal Shock damage. Kinetic damage now shows (7) and if selected will bring those back into the matching items list. Pistol is still selected as part of the criteria, but there are no pistols which deal Radiation damage, so the count falls to 0.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfUVCizhqSdj5AMxYTUsJg9IMSP4NEriEVF3sLUBBi7UbAI2y7sLrWkPbP7403D0oHuJWEiOIr2T3BGkXUUSX6mnPRJ4ZIwFkhIixQM-eyZV6qiHb7sytVvPKN2aqCHu_ipwl26?key=CmWrcAO1hsRfwUsQtzMvrA"][/img][/p][p]Now we can see that there are 3x SMG and 1x Assault Rifle that would match the rest of the filter [i]if [/i]those options were added to the filter's criteria. [/p][h3]Mark All Filtered[/h3][p]It's now also possible to mark items in bulk, which will apply the chosen mark to any items in the filter [i]which are not already marked[/i], the exact number of applicable items will display in parenthesis "(#)".[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcXL-zoTcDhcIbrH1b9kusiv6a2ADTNFd6jO2EZt_vp_8SxcCAOmBNDd5BbQH5RPoiKRFZRiUJX_oMgifm9F3ndnSYseVBevOKfBlBs6HRuJ5khkVwmpiWhML1Wb9bSsQA0F6VOaQ?key=CmWrcAO1hsRfwUsQtzMvrA"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXd_qZ0cJ69idayjQ8n-kcEVcqGHsGgl7chl7aLh__nLd7IR7Z4Oi0_RhBzON9SWfo4VcZwH0ppMIigGHJnm998JkrpGbaaOT_hbwtZKppjI7tZECuM8hPqSvpwUn6I9s4PAQQTM9A?key=CmWrcAO1hsRfwUsQtzMvrA"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeGdDomIvOJSrnZDhvMPglW5GZaukr-cT80hmQIAAqaITYcqvH-eqIam5fKbf98X4sshAir3K-MRmNOH4QW-JSvpu93ybuxfEgUpPFr9ySAh2X8mQU3jGD2Z81T8S66yT4XDRkIOA?key=CmWrcAO1hsRfwUsQtzMvrA"][/img][/p][h3]Send Items To Bank[/h3][p]When items have been flagged as "Bank" a prompt will appear to allow players to instantly send those marked items to their bank from anywhere in the world. [/p][p]Players will still need to access a physical bank in-game in order to retrieve items, but the ability to send items to the bank remotely works as long as there is still space in the bank to hold something.[/p][p] [img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfGsbaH3kpnyXDpkJnpXI6xF4CFUnRHfv3oBVAbH5CtzVCg_sh1rdMkRsEP-H9AI3ZPkgit_fXTHz0qoR041SxicJ2ZGybPYcOG8QFtABdVvwmlCqPrflNutol7RZg7Pj9LtRf3uA?key=CmWrcAO1hsRfwUsQtzMvrA"][/img][/p][p] [img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcth5cCFsdtUy2jsiybxGINshcqCkKMj77aEtzMDY8bhT8OHV5R_ktK-bMVOT9kldjfqRXqAlFqKV4Ttw6cVh_enNyOVYW9Nwg5GRjfTxVpnRNM_z5CjuUwUuwl4Vey71HPx5odSw?key=CmWrcAO1hsRfwUsQtzMvrA"][/img][/p][p]Some of the items we're trying to send to the bank are actually equipped right now, so maybe we don't want to send those items, just the ones flagged as "Bank" that aren't equipped should be sent for now.[/p][p] [img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXc1yImTEsAAJJguf3RvaYYTkw_BSEWLMMMaJ-S7JE8pU_yi7mpwggRNW40Xz5jG-VZWg1XZhl1uLvTFuJF_xcGgZr4lotCLnwFMoZicuKHmJphEcFlYdudcRGSoebgNZz7jt4BMkQ?key=CmWrcAO1hsRfwUsQtzMvrA"][/img][/p][p]We still have the two items that are flagged as "Bank" and are equipped. The bank now shows 2 items and our filtered item count decreased from 17 to 15, we've successfully transferred items.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdv393zwia71IbcnkOXBoa655WZT_zFJIgfkqk_Ke9XWDWNdcGkJP0tu3g-4NMlrmWmt3kMD6hgwFq0EdmJPzDw9K1urUbSgPC1SYR2oe4z8t1ezrcpix85bC5ovASwYsVTVPlDKA?key=CmWrcAO1hsRfwUsQtzMvrA"][/img][/p][h3]Behind the Team: Hunter Wolfe, [i]Borderlands 4[/i] Social Media Manager[/h3][p]Every week, we’re spotlighting one of the minds behind the mayhem. You’ll get to learn about folks from both Gearbox and 2K, and how each person who touches the game both influences and is influenced by [i]Borderlands 4[/i]. This week, we're talking with one of 2K’s Social Media Managers, [b]Hunter Wolfe:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]What does it look like for you to get into the mindset of the [i]Borderlands[/i] voice when you're working on something for social media?[/b][/p][p][b]Hunter Wolfe: [/b]When I'm writing copy or planning assets, I'll ask myself: is this unhinged enough? If it is, then mission accomplished! But if not, I'll workshop it. [i]Borderlands[/i] is all about being not-so-serious and oh-so-chaotic, after all.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]How important are your interactions online in the comments sections? What do you find most important about engaging with the community?[/b][/p][p][b]Hunter: [/b]Chatting with community members online is one of my favorite parts of the job! We're all [i]Borderlands[/i] nerds here, so getting to connect with fans on something we all love is just really fun.[/p][p]To the second part of your question though, I think replying to comments is important because it lets people know that they're part of a two-way conversation. Community feedback is massively important to us, and my hope is that when we reply to folks, it sends that message. I want our community to always feel like we're listening, because we are![/p][p][/p][p][b]If you were a Vault Hunter, what would you be packing?[/b][/p][p][b]Hunter: [/b]I'd make sure to pack a daily multivitamin, because most of the places you go in the [i]Borderlands [/i]games look like they'll give you tetanus, and I think you want to keep a healthy immune system on your adventures. That and probably a pistol that shoots potatoes. My siblings and I used to play with potato bazookas as a kid, so it feels like it'd be a fitting, lore-rooted part of my kit if I were a Vault Hunter.[/p][p]

[/p][h3]It’s the Community Creative Corner, Sugar[/h3][p]Our community members aren’t just gamers—many of you are also artists. Whether it’s cosplay, digital art, or some yet-to-be-invented medium, we’re your biggest fans. Check out this week’s hand-picked, Moxxi-themed fan creations:[/p][p][/p][p][i][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdU4AHOyZ_WLS3QfP8R6hRrKOGHROw65l5e4a_rXEtVHwtoe_HPVRQI389e2nmDTrLIfxR7Pz8Mq7dB2QnUKgkY3HJWucqY1XdYfZquyiogvlwIFRTqAur3oQvHjb-SbFd2KuH-RQ?key=CmWrcAO1hsRfwUsQtzMvrA"][/img][/i][/p][p][i][u][url="https://bsky.app/profile/dauverney.bsky.social"]- Dauverney[/url][/u][/i][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf8Sf0cBuPRUYGCcOxsoE6wnY_fNVQza_GfkijZkCj_l5nN0M5MRBwVs7HjjIDTZzYk6rctfByPSMkVh933kQzZ_TBsvVGPiWCt-xUw4HFPwEHNAAlGvjPvJZpu0xK76wbSmIngjg?key=CmWrcAO1hsRfwUsQtzMvrA"][/img][/p][p][u][url="https://www.tumblr.com/vishantidreams"]- vishantidreams [/url][/u][/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXex7Xp6ay-G_prWxO76GjIetjGSGXp9_J9OuM3MZPfIIiHsG-qzwShDehZeIRymBf36jLHWY0Ag7Scmh1UybGJbnoz5N1hfDj2b2SZH4sxxLjXfg83yvEm90lZwY0_UkyqMNWnR_g?key=CmWrcAO1hsRfwUsQtzMvrA"][/img][/p][p][u][url="https://www.tumblr.com/raven-cl"]- Raven[/url][/u][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcDAdVwJgP1T2MfSQP_TA7zqaEqo5V-xpj7HbqnY0FAtW2HUvzw-g7Ag-cdSXHN2gFWkee9cKFnRSl_c8s7UH97DwnNAQEqAjrMCxJWs4f9vjJQcH9XC3Ek1ij6Gx7-L1H78Ed6EA?key=CmWrcAO1hsRfwUsQtzMvrA"][/img][/p][p]That’s it for this week—more updates, more chaos, and maybe a few surprises coming next Friday. Until then: keep your ECHOnet tuned and your loot luck high.[/p][p]Happy Hunting,
[b]The Borderlands Team[/b][/p][p align="center"][b][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfNIdHOsmxNfYhoG7ThtccEaoypIJxCEgHIy7gHwargQ76R4xnSHV52iIWT8cggWqG3TMF2oQJff6LTMzEDXdKmUAGWkRJpmwbxiiLPVNmztj0Jxz_IZ-AM2y7BUMK_qXy3moqQEQ?key=CmWrcAO1hsRfwUsQtzMvrA"][/img][/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1285190/Borderlands_4/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Borderlands 4 will ditch predecessor's toilet humor, say devs
notes.content:
What was your favorite part of Borderlands 3? Was it the toilet humor? I'm guessing not, and Gearbox Software has admitted that leaning heavily on fart gags, as a substitute for some of the series' regular comedy and dark humor, was a mistake. Fortunately, the developer has confirmed that Borderlands 4 won't be making that same blunder. Instead, this sequel aims to nail the balance between comedy and pathos, without splattering poop jokes everywhere. And while there are lavatories in the game, Skibidi Toilet absolutely won't get a look in.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Borderlands 4's Gravitar Harlowe reminds me why I fell in love with the series
notes.content:
Gearbox has opened the proverbial Pandora's Box on the last of the four Borderlands 4 leads, 'Gravitar' Harlowe, and I'm immediately put in mind of some of my personal highlights of the FPS series. An ex Maliwan scientist, Harlowe brings all manner of gadget-based trickery to the table. She can connect enemies to make them share damage, lock them in stasis, drag them around and lead them into giant explosions, and all while looking great doing it. If you're a big fan of crowd-control effects, were a Maya main in Borderlands 2, or can't get enough of Mass Effect's Asari Adept, you should be very excited.

notes.title: THIS WEEK ON KAIROS
notes.content:
[p]Hey Vault Hunters! Welcome to “This Week on Kairos” - a weekly post where we share everything happening across the world of [i]Borderlands 4[/i], from developer updates to community highlights and beyond.[/p][p]Every Friday, we’ll be here with the latest news, fan creations, dev spotlights, helpful resources, and anything else we think you’ll want to see. Whether you're looking to catch up, dive deeper, or just see what your fellow players are up to, this is the place.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/8fb96d3607a8c746d71170c41f4f49a7cb5b5dbd.png"][/img][/p][h3]Cross-Play, Cross-Save, and Cross-Progression News[/h3][p]We’re thrilled to reaffirm that [b][i]Borderlands 4[/i] WILL support full cross-play[/b] at launch - meaning you can team up with your friends across platforms. No matter where your squad is, you can hunt all the Vaults together.[/p][p]We also want to take a moment to clarify some terms, so everyone, including new Vault Hunters, knows what to expect:[/p][list][*][p][b]Cross-play[/b] means players on different platforms can play together online.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cross-save[/b] means your save file can move between platforms (like playing on a console one day and continuing on PC the next).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cross-progression[/b] refers to your account-based progress - like unlocks, loot, etc. - being shared across platforms.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Please note that cross-save and cross-progression will not be supported at launch[/b]. We know this may be frustrating for some players, and we hear you. This is on our radar, and we appreciate all of your feedback.[/p][p]In the meantime, every platform will still offer the full [i]Borderlands 4[/i] experience, and we’ve worked hard to make sure it's smooth, chaotic, and a joy to play - wherever you drop in. Thanks for being part of this incredible community.[/p][p]

[/p][h3]Maxroll’s Build Planner is Live[/h3][p]Huge shoutout to our friends at [b]Maxroll[/b] for launching their [b][i]Borderlands 4[/i] Build Planner[/b]! Whether you’re theorycrafting your initial build or already min-maxing your skill tree, this is [i]the[/i] place to start mapping your mayhem. A huge thank you to some of our most dedicated creators for all their work on this project.
[/p][p][url="https://maxroll.gg/borderlands-4/planner"]https://maxroll.gg/borderlands-4/planner[/url][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/5d93c4255efce9dabe192a3dfd3a60ec7b669a08.png"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h3]The Final Countdown[/h3][p]Want a daily dose of [i]Borderlands[/i] conversation? Reddit user UpwardSpiral00 has dedicated their time to a Daily Countdown, with a question of the day to keep the hypotheses, speculation, and launch day energy flowing. You can let them know what you think [u][url="https://www.reddit.com/r/Borderlands4/?f=flair_name%3A%22%E2%8F%B3%20%5B%20%F0%9D%97%97%F0%9D%97%94%F0%9D%97%9C%F0%9D%97%9F%F0%9D%97%AC%20%F0%9D%97%96%F0%9D%97%A2%F0%9D%97%A8%F0%9D%97%A1%F0%9D%97%A7%F0%9D%97%97%F0%9D%97%A2%F0%9D%97%AA%F0%9D%97%A1%20%5D%22"]here[/url][/u]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/aa005241519b98e383e8d56fe0c4a27b6d3ca54d.png"][/img][/p][h3]Zines Are Back, Baby![/h3][p]Did you know there’s a [i]Borderlands[/i] fanzine? Some incredibly creative folks in the community put together a 100-page digital zine full of art, stories, and other cool content for everyone to enjoy. It’s free and definitely worth a download! Check out The Border\[line] Zine on their [u][url="https://borderlandszine.itch.io/borderline-zine"]itch.io[/url][/u] page![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/813e0dd7a09b451571aecd7d7f3257aafd8f8061.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Cover art by [u][url="https://www.tumblr.com/willczek-art"]Hellzelian[/url][/u][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/3eb983867a8afaee766c69b0e8e47126b05a0d15.png"][/img][/p][h3]Behind the Team: Christina Bonet, [i]Borderlands 4[/i] Lead UX Designer[/h3][p]Every week, we’re spotlighting one of the minds behind the mayhem. You’ll get to learn about folks from both Gearbox and 2K, and how each person who touches the game both influences and is influenced by [i]Borderlands 4[/i]. This week, we're talking with [b]Christina Bonet[/b], Gearbox’s Lead UX Designer[b]:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]When you’re designing player experiences, what’s your North Star or guiding principle?[/b][/p][p][b]Christina Bonet: [/b]When designing player experiences, my guiding principle is thinking of how to best design our UX for a diverse player base. I want our designs and interactions to appeal to new players and returning players alike. They should be easily understandable and accessible, so that as many people as possible can enjoy the work my team and I create.[/p][p][/p][p][b] Are there any small details players might not notice at first that took a lot of thought to design?[/b][/p][p][b]Christina: [/b]Our HUD design is the first thing that comes to mind. [i]Borderlands 4[/i] is a complex game, and there are many components within the HUD that have to work together to create a cohesive experience. Everything from notifications to the player's health and shield information, to the Action Skill buttons, have individual complexities and behaviors. The UX team works closely with our extremely talented UI art, code, game design, and QA teams to ensure that each part of the HUD is the best it can be.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What inspired you to get into UX design for games?[/b][/p][p][b]Christina: [/b]Good question! I've played videogames for most of my life, and after graduating college, I knew that I wanted to work in the games industry. But I wasn't sure in what capacity - UX design as we know it today didn't exist back then. But I knew I had an interest in UI because I was already modding my UIs in games and finding it fun. It was after I got the chance to move from UI into UX \[User Interface into User Experience] a few years into my career that I knew it was the department for me. Designing interactions, championing accessibility, and advocating for a good player experience are things I genuinely enjoy. So, in a roundabout way, UI inspired me to get into UX design.[/p][p]

[/p][h3]Community Creative Corner[/h3][p]Our community members aren’t just gamers—many of you are also artists. Whether it’s cosplay, digital art, or some yet-to-be-invented medium, we’re your biggest fans. Check out this week’s hand-picked fan creations:[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/68446bdcdc4da567fe571b31996ee28af20911c7.jpg"][/img][url="https://www.tumblr.com/hyperwitch"]- hyperwitch[/url][/h3][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/7b1c415afa4feefe575a5dde336bfa880cfd95a7.jpg"][/img][url="https://bsky.app/profile/catxiphos.bsky.social"]- Xiphos art[/url] [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/1ac8af64c921b9f8d4366cd8d0041e552a892963.png"][/img][/p][p]That’s it for this week—more updates, more chaos, and maybe a few surprises coming next Friday. Until then: keep your ECHOnet tuned and your loot luck high.[/p][p]Happy Hunting,
[b]The Borderlands Team[/b][/p][p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/cab2860dd2091c9cc501e726e1b96f9a4579849a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1285190/Borderlands_4/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Harlowe Gameplay Overview
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="EDrYNvTaFHs;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Nothing says "power fantasy" like wiping out waves of enemies with a combination of crowd-control abilities and area-of-effect annihilation—both of which happen to be the specialty of Harlowe the Gravitar, one of the four all-new Vault Hunters wreaking havoc on Kairos in [i]Borderlands 4[/i]! Using her collection of combat-ready inventions, Harlowe can dominate any space by nuking the battlefield with Cryo and Radiation damage, or protect herself and co-op allies with enhanced shielding and more.[/p][p]Check out the Harlowe Gameplay Overview video above to see her scientific brilliance applied in the field to deadly effect. Whatever hypotheses and variables she's testing in a given firefight, the results are sure to be joyously bloody.[/p][p]Check out the full rundown of her abilities and three skill trees on the [u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/harlowe/"]Harlowe Vault Hunter page[/url][/u] nested within the [u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/"]Game Info page[/url][/u]. Here's a high-level overview of the core Action Skills that Harlowe has access to:[/p][list][*][p][b]CHROMA Accelerator:[/b] Fire off an Unstable Energy Pocket that creates a sphere of Cryo damage which passes through enemies, then detonate it for an explosive finish of Radiation damage that'll fry any surviving targets. With the Capstone abilities of her Creative Bursts skill tree, Harlowe can engineer the Unstable Energy Pocket to bounce between foes or gain multiple charges.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Zero-Point: [/b]Turn aggressive enemies into defenseless targets by isolating them in a zero-gravity Stasis bubble created by Harlowe's HALO Accelerator, which slams them to the ground when the Stasis effect ends. Longtime [i]Borderlands [/i]players will recognize this as a spin on an iconic Siren skill, now with added Augments that can cause bullets to ricochet off targets in Stasis, store damage on bubbled enemies to create living Cryo bombs that detonate on impact, and more. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Flux Generator: [/b]Drop a repositionable Flux Generator that creates a sizable Energy Field, freezing enemies with constant Cryo damage and empowering nearby allies with Overshield. Through the use of Augments, you can amplify or add to the effects that hinder foes and help allies while they're in the Energy Field.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/b3081ff65eeeffdf9c256fdd76207d2f91d55484.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Harlowe's always-on Trait [b]Entanglement [/b]is where her area-of-effect, crowd-decimating strengths really come into focus. Whenever Harlowe uses her Action Skill on enemies, they become Entangled, indicated by a chromatic glow. Entangled enemies share a portion of Gun Damage and Skill Damage, effectively spreading the hurt across multiple targets to make quick work of even the toughest groups.[/p][p]With the debut of Harlowe's full suite of abilities, you can now browse the skill trees for [i]Borderlands 4[/i]'s all-new Vault Hunters on the [u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/vex/"]Vex Vault Hunter[/url][/u], [u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/rafa/"]Rafa Vault Hunter[/url][/u], [u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/amon/"]Amon Vault Hunter[/url][/u], and [u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/harlowe/"]Harlowe Vault Hunter[/url][/u] pages. Let the theorycrafting commence as you try to decide which of these badasses you'll embody in your fight against the Timekeeper; it's also a very acceptable plan to play as all four because you can't choose just one.[/p][p][i]Borderlands 4[/i] is now available for pre-purchase. We're so excited that you'll all be crash-landing on Kairos soon; stay tuned for more reveals ahead of launch![/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1285190/Borderlands_4/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

Despite Pitchford saying yet more stuff this week, we've been at Gamescom with the devs themselves to hear more about Borderlands 4, from how the devs approached the zippy traversal, to the question of post-launch DLC.

notes.title: Unmasking the Madness of Borderlands 4 with Art Director Adam May
notes.content:
Borderlands has always had this way of blending chaos, humor, and pure, unfiltered spectacle into a world that feels alive and ridiculous all at once. So when I got the chance to sit down with Adam May, the art director on Borderlands 4, I knew I was going to come away excited and more hyped up for Borderlands. Adam’s been shaping the series from the very beginning, helping craft the look, the feel, and yes, even the insane characters that make this universe so addictive.

Talking with Adam reminded me why I keep coming back to Pandora after all these years. Borderlands 4 doesn’t just push the series forward. It embraces everything fans love while finding new ways to surprise and delight. From the environments to the characters to those insane, over-the-top set pieces, it’s clear that Gearbox is building a world that’s as rich, weird, and chaotic as ever. For longtime fans like me, it’s an exciting evolution. And for newcomers, it’s a perfect entry point into one of gaming’s most... Read more

notes.title: THIS WEEK ON KAIROS
notes.content:
[p]Hey Vault Hunters! Welcome to “This Week on Kairos” - a weekly post where we share everything happening across the world of [i]Borderlands 4[/i], from developer updates to community highlights and beyond.[/p][p]Every Friday, we’ll be here with the latest news, fan creations, dev spotlights, helpful resources, and anything else we think you’ll want to see. Whether you're looking to catch up, dive deeper, or just see what your fellow players are up to, this is the place.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/1ac8af64c921b9f8d4366cd8d0041e552a892963.png"][/img][/p][h3]More Vault Hunter Content, Please![/h3][p]It’s been “Amonlands” all week, and we've loved seeing all the hype and feedback about our Viking boy. While we know you’re all ready for “Harlowelands,” let’s do one more recap of our favorite Forgeknight:[/p][p]
These two gameplay-focused videos showcase Amon’s skills and abilities, along with a behind-the-scenes look at the creation of his complex class kit that revolves around Forgeweapons:[/p][h2][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/tcAu2pyYCpg"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/QeQZ4UxRE_8"][/dynamiclink][/h2][p]Amon's Character Short "Demons" features his retelling of a run-in with a Vault-obsessed cult much like the one he survived: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s_36fMCjNcI"][/dynamiclink] [/p][h3]We’re Going to Gamescom![/h3][p]Gamescom, located in Cologne, Germany, is the biggest video game convention in the WORLD, and we’re giving the show a taste of Kairos. The [i]Borderlands[/i] Team will be at Gamescom all weekend, where fans can get hands-on gameplay as ALL FOUR VAULT HUNTERS for the first time! We’ll be located in Hall 6, Booth B011 from August 20-24, and we cannot WAIT to see you there![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/791ba1f8b506f223f099a229296befe241fa56b6.jpg"][/img]
[/p][h3]Cosplay Guides are HERE![/h3][p]To all our amazing Cosplayers - we know you’ve been waiting for the official Vault Hunter cosplay guides, and we are so excited to share them with you! You can find them on our website's [u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/community/"]Community hub[/url][/u], and we can’t wait to see what incredible creations come out of it![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/4ab4a765377a5a300e0213ecdac6d98e9beca218.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Behind the Team: Lo Daniels, [i]Borderlands 4[/i] Qualitative Analyst[/h3][p]Every week, we’re spotlighting one of the minds behind the mayhem. You’ll get to learn about folks from both Gearbox and 2K, and how each person who touches the game both influences and is influenced by [i]Borderlands 4[/i]. This week, we're talking with one of 2K’s Qualitative Analysts, [b]Lo Daniels:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]What advice would you give someone who wants to get into game QA?[/b][/p][p][b]Lo Daniels: [/b]When I was much younger, I always knew I wanted a job in QA - but the people around me would constantly tell me to focus on getting a "real job" (back then, video game careers were not taken very seriously). This feedback from my friends kept me from pursuing that dream for a long time.[/p][p]Once I finally decided to go for it, I immediately felt the level of fulfillment that I had always expected. My advice to all of you out there is this: If video game QA is something you truly want to do as a career, then go for it and don't let anyone stop you. Knowing how something works makes it easier to break, so learn everything you can about video games. Also, learn the difference between playing, testing, and playtesting.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What makes testing a [i]Borderlands[/i] game different from other types of games?[/b][/p][p][b]Lo: [/b]Unlike other games I've tested, this one is an emotional investment, so it took some extra effort to get locked in. When the original [i]Borderlands[/i] released, I was working a dead-end retail job that felt like a soulless grind. At the end of my days, I would get home, load up [i]BL1[/i], and lose myself in the endless pursuit of power and riches. I’ve been a fan of the series ever since.[/p][p]Being in the credits of a [i]Borderlands[/i] title has always been on my QA bucket list, and when I started working on [i]BL4[/i], it was hard to not feel super overwhelmed at first. Here I was, just some guy, tasked with ensuring the quality of one of the most influential looter shooters of all time, one that I had this deep emotional connection to... It was a lot to take in.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Who is going to be your main in [i]Borderlands 4[/i] and why?[/b][/p][p][b]Lo: [/b]Everyone. I love all my Vault Hunters equally, but Harlowe will most likely be my first playthrough. She was the first Vault Hunter I picked. She’s skilled, determined, and always willing to help others with whatever it is they are trying to accomplish. These are qualities that I like to think I have myself which is why I... [i]gravitated[/i] towards her *wink*.[/p][p]

notes.title: THIS WEEK ON KAIROS
notes.content:
[p]Hey Vault Hunters! Welcome to the very first edition of “This Week on Kairos” - a new weekly post where we share everything happening across the world of [i]Borderlands 4[/i], from developer updates to community highlights and beyond.[/p][p]Every Friday, we’ll be here with the latest news, fan creations, dev spotlights, helpful resources, and anything else we think you’ll want to see. Whether you're looking to catch up, dive deeper, or just see what your fellow players are up to, this is the place.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/4b67de79a041ff6e22b99f1e28acb97d774dc818.png"][/img][/p][h2]In Case You Missed It: Vault Hunter Trailers are Here[/h2][p]We’ve started rolling out cinematic trailers for the Vault Hunters, and if you haven’t seen them yet... where have you been?![/p][p]Catch up on the Character Shorts we’ve shared and get to know the faces you’ll be taking into the fray. And since it’s Amon’s week, keep an eye out for his story soon!  [i] [/i][/p][p][/p][p]"Purple Friday" feature’s Vex's retelling of the events that set her down the path to becoming a Vault Hunter:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/BzgZvUMgtSs"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]"YOLT" features Rafa’s retelling of how he ended up going AWOL after cutting ties with the Tediore corporation:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/REP1cuGbP-8"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h2]We've Gone Gold[/h2][p][b][i]Borderlands 4[/i] is officially gold![/b] That means the game is locked, loaded, and ready for its journey to your screen.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/6fb2c88be4eeea9c113cce0c69fed95eba13b3a7.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][/h2][h2][i]Borderlands[/i] for a Cause: The Hunt[/h2][p]We want to call out a special community initiative for good. For years, members of the Borderlands community have come together to host [b]The Hunt[/b], a charity streaming marathon benefitting [b]St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital[/b]. To date, they’ve raised over $500,000 total to benefit children’s health by participating in scavenger hunts across the Borderlands games. [/p][p][/p][p]It’s always incredible to see the community mobilize during these events. The Hunt: Prepare for Mayh3m will take place from August 15-24. For more information, check out The Hunt website: [/p][p][url="https://p4m.borderlandshunt.com/"]https://p4m.borderlandshunt.com/[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/f01df06ad759cf7de96cdcfbcfd527b2841484b6.png"][/img][/p][h2]Behind the Team: Sam Winkler, [i]Borderlands 4[/i] Narrative Director[/h2][p]Every week, we’re spotlighting one of the minds behind the mayhem. You’ll get to learn about folks from both Gearbox and 2K, and how each person who touches the game both influences and is influenced by [i]Borderlands 4[/i]. This week, we're talking with [b]Sam Winkler, [i]Borderlands 4's [/i]Narrative Director (Gearbox):[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Sam Winkler: [/b]Thank you for having me, it’s an honor to be part of ThWoK![/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s the most ridiculous thing you pitched for any [i]Borderlands[/i] game that you can’t believe made it in? [/b][/p][p][b]Sam Winkler: [/b]There’s a mountain of these, but the most recent would be Vex’s character short, “Purple Friday”. The moment when someone becomes a Siren is a big thing, and it was really tempting to make it some grand dramatic experience. I wrote a few versions that were more action-focused and “cool”, for lack of a better word, but I was dissatisfied because the Borderlands vibe wasn’t there. So I decided to start out with a corner of the universe that you wouldn’t normally see, something a little more mundane, and [i]then[/i] bring the mayhem in. Sometimes the Borderlands comes to you.[/p][p]Close second: Maurice, the talking velociraptor with a gambling problem.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s the weirdest thing on your desk that somehow helps your writing process? [/b][/p][p][b]Sam:[/b] I have a fidget knife. I flip it around sometimes while I’m thinking. It’s a balisong, which can look really sweet if you know how to use it, which I don’t. I’ve had it for twenty years and at this point it’s so dull I don’t know if it could cut margarine.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What part of [i]Borderlands[/i] [i]4 [/i]are you most excited for players to experience? No spoilers, please! [/b][/p][p][b]Sam: [/b]I’m excited for everyone to find all the hidden corners of the world where the team has injected their own little details. There’s just a ton of personality everywhere – staged scenes in the environment, niche names of spaces and gear, ancient caves containing damning truths and untold sorrows. That sort of thing.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]Community Creative Corner[/h2][p]Our community members aren’t just gamers—many of you are also artists. Whether it’s cosplay, digital art, or some yet-to-be-invented medium, we’re your biggest fans. Check out this week’s hand-picked fan creations:[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/0046f76ed1c2447db3fda6abaf9a7f34523f6302.jpg"][/img][u][url="https://www.tumblr.com/flippythedog200"]flippythedog200[/url][/u] [/h3][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/187c7abb235c2531a5275ef533e5b8573d5d4448.jpg"][/img][u][url="https://mostwantedpotato404.tumblr.com/"]Mostwantedpotato404[/url][/u][/h3][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/b10deb3b384b4ef94f860096725cc4f1099c7504.jpg"][/img][u][url="https://artfullysinful.carrd.co/"]artfullysinful[/url][/u][/h3][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/f72c8de5831f110f20bd4f2bca5015e923864647.png"][/img][/p][p]That’s it for this week—more updates, more chaos, and maybe a few surprises coming next Friday. Until then: keep your ECHOnet tuned and your loot luck high.[/p][p][/p][p]Happy Hunting,
[b]The Borderlands Team[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/cab2860dd2091c9cc501e726e1b96f9a4579849a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1285190/Borderlands_4/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Amon Gameplay Overview
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="4lCbxjy0zI4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]If you love running headfirst into battle, soaking up damage and dishing it out in equal measure, you'd do well to check out Amon the Forgeknight, one of the four all-new Vault Hunters wreaking havoc on Kairos in [i]Borderlands 4[/i]! In addition to being a resilient frontliner, Amon has a mechanically complex set of Action Skills with primary and secondary functions that'll tickle the cortexes of even the most experienced players.[/p][p]Watch the Amon Gameplay Overview video above to watch Amon tear his enemies asunder with an arsenal of Forgeweapons, which take form via the Forgedrones stored within Amon's cybernetic-enhanced beefcake body. Amon can attack or defend as needed, ready to pulverize enemies with a Forgehammer, slice them in twain with Forgeaxes, soak up damage with a Forgeshield, and much, much more.[/p][p]Check out the full rundown of his abilities and three skill trees on the [u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/amon/"]Amon Vault Hunter page[/url][/u] nested within the [u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/"]Game Info page[/url][/u]. Here's a high-level overview of the core Action Skills that Amon can unleash:[/p][list][*][p][b]Crucible: [/b]Wield the elemental might of fire and ice with Amon's twin Forgeaxes, which deal Incendiary or Cryo damage by default, have multiple charges, and can be picked up to reduce their cooldown. The Forgeaxes make any damaged target Primed, causing them to explode in a damaging, bloody mess when killed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scourge: [/b]Charge headlong into the fray as Amon summons his Forgeshield, which will soak up incoming damage and fill up a Vengeance Meter. Once you've absorbed the brunt of the incoming hurt, you can return the favor by firing back a Forgewave that consumes Vengeance to deal freezing Cryo damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Onslaughter: [/b]Wallop your foes in the face with Amon's Forgefist, which dashes to your target to unleash an explosive Rocket Punch. The force of this Incendiary Melee Damage impact will Stagger most enemies, leaving them dazed so you can finish them off with a flurry of bullets.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfbxSn72BiURdhBpTS3nvMuFivV8_odIyter-eZYQZLGXT92l_6JReposYb4zmsYwlPSbUzokFhfVB2IRpQ4Ww5NeiClb_7HZ9gyU-htQ0a7znz51b3SICiq67JDon7CTC0IjWZng?key=lwOxNK4FpCT-0SCCqtJ7lw"][/img][/p][p]Amon's Trait [b]Forgeskill[/b] is where things really heat up, as it grants a secondary Action Skill depending on his equipped core Action Skill. Forgeskills have their own cooldown separate from their respective Action Skill, adding an extra layer of complexity to Amon's damage output as you master his cooldown rotations during battle. Here are Amon's Forgeskills, all of which can be transformed by the Capstone abilities at the end of his skill trees:[/p][list][*][p][b]Double-Edge (Crucible Action Skill equipped):[/b] Throw a twinned Forgeaxe, dealing Cryo  Damage to enemies it passes through and returning to Amon, dealing Incendiary Melee Damage on the way back.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Firewall (Scourge Action Skill equipped):[/b] Deploy a Firewall that absorbs enemy projectiles, and grants friendly projectiles that pass through it increased damage and velocity. Absorbed damage is converted into Vengeance if Scourge is active, and enemies near Firewall get burned with Incendiary damage over time.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Molten Slam (Onslaughter Action Skill equipped):[/b] Slam a Molten Forgehammer into the ground, dealing Incendiary damage to enemies in a large area.[/p][/*][/list][p]If you haven't seen them already, make sure to peruse the [u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/vex/"]Vex Vault Hunter[/url][/u] and [u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/rafa/"]Rafa Vault Hunter[/url][/u] pages with all of their Action Skill and skill tree information, then keep your eyes peeled for the Harlowe Vault Hunter pages in the coming weeks.[/p][p][i]Borderlands 4 [/i]is now available for pre-purchase! We're so excited that you'll all be crash-landing on Kairos soon; stay tuned for more reveals ahead of launch![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1285190/Borderlands_4/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Rafa Gameplay Overview
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="QNxaHZ8HcmU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Classes based around the 'elite soldier' archetype are a staple of [i]Borderlands[/i], acting as a great gateway for FPS players to acclimate to the unbridled mayhem of the series' frenetic combat. Rafa the Exo-Soldier is here to continue the franchise lineage of the battle-ready combat veteran class, making his debut as one of the all-new Vault Hunters breaking free in [i]Borderlands 4[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the Rafa Gameplay Overview video above to see how he masterfully wields the cutting-edge weaponry stored in his Deadframe exo-suit. This former Tediore trooper is ready for fights at any distance, whether he's slicing through enemies at melee range with his twin Arc-Knives, perforating midrange targets with his Peacebreaker Cannons, or blasting holes through multiple enemies with charged-up rounds from his APOPHIS Lance.[/p][p] [/p][p]Here's a high-level overview of the core Action Skills that Rafa has at the ready:[/p][list][*][p][b]Arc-Knives: [/b]Cut down anyone stupid enough to stand in your way with these twin energy blades. When activating Rafa's Arc-Knives, your perspective shifts from first-person to third-person, giving you maximum spatial awareness as you slash, dash, and slice your way through hostile crowds. The finishing touch on any melee carnage spree is Rafa's Blade Fury ability, which ends the Action Skill with a Shock Damage-infused whirlwind strike.  [/p][/*][*][p][b]Peacebreaker Cannons:[/b] Amplify your damage output with an extra gun over each shoulder, as the Peacebreaker Cannons seek and destroy any targets in front of you. You get multiple charges with each activation, so take your pick between firing off a volley of blasts or charging up devastating projectiles depending on the situation.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Rafa's always-on Trait, [b]Overdrive[/b], incentivizes you to keep using your Action Skills on cooldown, buffing your movespeed and damage whenever an Action Skill is active. Once you've found the rhythm of using your favorite Action Skill multiple times in each skirmish, you'll be tearing through the opposition with ease.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/5f80eac8ce09db115b87bcff3b0f8e73739289b3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In case you missed it, be sure to check out the [u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/game-info/vault-hunters/vex/"]Vex Vault Hunter page[/url][/u], detailing all of the Siren's supernatural Action Skills and skill trees. notes.title: Vex Spotlight - Gameplay Overview, Character Short
notes.content:
[previewyoutube="LzC0TYyH6nk;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Sirens are one of the most iconic classes in all of [i]Borderlands[/i], with supernatural Phase abilities that augment their run-and-gun expertise. It's high time we formally introduced you to Vex the Siren, one of the four all-new Vault Hunters who are wreaking havoc on Kairos in [i]Borderlands 4[/i]! 

In the Vex Gameplay Overview above, you can witness Vex's destructive Phase energy in action, whether she's blasting enemies to bits with elemental orbs, summoning an entourage of aggressive Phase Clones, or letting her adorable (and deadly) feline Phase Phamiliar, aptly named Trouble, tear the opposition limb from limb. If you're generally a fan of companion classes or like to rack up kills with elemental damage, Vex is a great choice.

Here's a high-level overview of the core Action Skill abilities Vex has at her disposal:

[/p][list][*][p][b]Dead Ringer[/b]: Use multiple charges to spawn in a posse of Phase Clone Minions, which can be melee-slashing, enemy-taunting Reapers or immobile, turret-style Specters. These Minions aren't long for this world as they continually lose health the moment they spawn in, so enjoy their murderous tendencies while they last.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Incarnate[/b]: Unleash devastating area-of-effect damage with Incarnate's initial Phase Explosion, decimating nearby aggressors and fully healing Vex in the process. She then enters a temporary powered-up state (peep that skeletal wingspan) which has faster movement and the ability to fire off blistering Eldritch Blasts.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Phase Phamiliar[/b]: Invite Trouble to show off what a good boy he is, particularly when it comes to chomping down on enemies or fatally smacking them to bits with his tail. When it's time to take out a high-priority target, Trouble can teleport on top of them with an instantly damaging blast before taking on an even more Badass form.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/51cc33ecfa74a654c07bb8824f24d4603ce10a00.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Skill tree fundamentals[/h2][p]
Every Vault Hunter has access to three unique Action Skills, but only one can be equipped at a time. They also have three distinct skill trees, each stemming from an Action Skill. 

By investing points into a skill tree and unlocking its deeper layers, you'll gain access to [b]Augments [/b]that provide secondary bonuses to your Action Skills, and [b]Capstones [/b]which modify or override specific Action Skill functionalities. Augments and Capstones can only be slotted into the Action Skill for that respective skill tree. Only one Capstone can be equipped at a time, and the same is typically true for Augments. 

You can use Action Skills from other skill trees even if you haven't invested any points into them, but you won't be able to equip the powerful Augments or Capstones from one skill tree onto the Action Skill of a different skill tree. Committing Skill Points to the skill tree that will properly synergize with your favorite Action Skill is key!

Each Vault Hunter also has their own [b]Trait[/b]: an always-on passive effect that doesn't require any skill points. Vex's Trait is [b]Phase Covenant[/b], which attunes her Action Skill and melee damage to the same Elemental Type as the gun she's currently wielding. Elemental damage types are critical for taking down tougher enemies on higher difficulty levels, so Phase Covenant is a gift that keeps on giving while you level up, incentivizing you to curate a loadout with differing elemental damage guns that ensure you're ready for anything.

[/p][previewyoutube="BzgZvUMgtSs;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
Above, you can watch Vex's new Character Short "Purple Friday," featuring Vex's retelling of the events that set her down the path to becoming a Vault Hunter.

[/p][h2]More to come[/h2][p]
We'll also be rolling out dedicated Vault Hunter pages for the remaining crew members Rafa, Amon, and Harlowe, each with their own Gameplay Overview and Character Short, so stay tuned for those!
